example.en: Students declare their major at the end of second year.
example.zh: 学生在二年级结束时宣布他们的专业。

example.en: Students receive marks based on their performance in assignments.
example.zh: 学生根据作业表现获得分数。

example.en: The health center provides free medical services to students.
example.zh: 健康中心为学生提供免费医疗服务。

example.en: Getting enough sleep is important for academic performance.
example.zh: 充足的睡眠对学习成绩很重要。

example.en: The botanical garden is a peaceful place for studying.
example.zh: 植物园是学习的宁静之地。

example.zh: 学生公寓的月租金从五百英镑起。

example.en: Remember to lock your room when you leave.
example.zh: 离开时记得锁好你的房间。

example.zh: 我在校园附近找住处遇到了麻烦。

example.en: The cafeteria offers a separate menu for vegetarians.
example.zh: 食堂为素食主义者提供单独的菜单。

example.en: The lecture will be held in the main hall at ten o'clock.
example.zh: 讲座将于十点在大礼堂举行。

example.en: Please write your name, age and occupation on the form.
example.zh: 请在表格上写下你的姓名、年龄和职业。

example.en: Good communication skills are essential for group projects.
example.zh: 良好的沟通能力对小组项目至关重要。

example.en: The existing library building will be extended next year.
example.zh: 现有的图书馆大楼明年将会扩建。

example.en: The university welcomes international students from over fifty countries.
example.zh: 这所大学欢迎来自五十多个国家的国际学生。

example.en: Do you fancy going to the museum this weekend?
example.zh: 这个周末你想去博物馆吗？

example.en: She works for a law firm in the city centre.
example.zh: 她在市中心的一家律师事务所工作。

example.en: The reserve protects the natural habitat of many rare birds.
example.zh: 保护区保护着许多珍稀鸟类的自然栖息地。

example.en: Recycling is one solution to the problem of waste.
example.zh: 回收利用是解决垃圾问题的一个方案。

example.en: Finishing the essay is my top priority this week.
example.zh: 完成这篇论文是我本周的头等大事。

example.en: The bookshop is having a sale on second-hand textbooks.
example.zh: 书店正在打折出售二手教材。

example.en: The photography exhibition runs until the end of March.
example.zh: 摄影展将持续到三月底。

example.en: The company plans to recruit twenty new graduates this year.
example.zh: 这家公司计划今年招聘二十名应届毕业生。

example.en: The club organises various activities for new members.
example.zh: 俱乐部为新成员组织各种各样的活动。

example.en: You can pay the deposit by credit card.
example.zh: 你可以用信用卡支付押金。

example.en: Travelers are advised to book their tickets in advance.
example.zh: 建议旅客提前订票。

example.en: The swimming pool is closed on Sunday mornings.
example.zh: 游泳池周日上午不开放。

example.en: This is her first visit to an English-speaking country.
example.zh: 这是她第一次访问英语国家。

example.en: He is writing a paper on the history of the local castle.
example.zh: 他正在写一篇关于当地城堡历史的论文。

example.en: I heard about the job vacancy on the local radio.
example.zh: 我是从当地电台听说这个职位空缺的。

example.en: This course is designed for students at an intermediate level.
example.zh: 这门课程是为中等水平的学生设计的。

example.en: Soft drinks are not allowed in the computer room.
example.zh: 机房里不允许带软饮料。

example.en: The students' union organises a welcome party every October.
example.zh: 学生会每年十月都会组织迎新晚会。

example.en: They offer a ten percent discount for group bookings.
example.zh: 他们为团体预订提供九折优惠。

example.en: A return ticket to London costs twenty-five pounds.
example.zh: 去伦敦的往返票价为二十五英镑。

example.en: The hotel is famous for the high quality of its service.
example.zh: 这家酒店以高质量的服务而闻名。

example.en: Learning a second language takes time and patience.
example.zh: 学习第二门语言需要时间和耐心。

example.en: Factories must reduce the pollution they release into the environment.
example.zh: 工厂必须减少向环境排放的污染。

example.en: The experiment was carried out under strict laboratory conditions.
example.zh: 这项实验是在严格的实验室条件下进行的。

example.en: The novel has attracted millions of young readers worldwide.
example.zh: 这部小说吸引了全世界数百万年轻读者。

example.en: The café is a popular meeting place for students.
example.zh: 这家咖啡馆是学生们喜爱的聚会地点。

example.en: You don't need to wear formal dress to the seminar.
example.zh: 参加研讨会不需要穿正装。

example.en: The class was divided into groups of four for the discussion.
example.zh: 全班被分成四人小组进行讨论。

example.en: Shark attacks on swimmers are actually extremely rare.
example.zh: 鲨鱼袭击游泳者的事件其实极为罕见。

example.en: Recent studies show that sleep improves memory.
example.zh: 最近的研究表明睡眠能改善记忆力。

example.en: My tutor made a useful suggestion about my essay structure.
example.zh: 导师对我的论文结构提出了一条有用的建议。

example.en: Falcons can spot small prey from a great height.
example.zh: 猎鹰能从很高的地方发现小猎物。

example.en: Please keep your yellow registration form until the end of term.
example.zh: 请保留你的黄色注册表直到学期结束。

example.en: The cleaning of the dormitory kitchens is done every Friday.
example.zh: 宿舍厨房每周五进行清洁。

example.en: She is studying hotel management at a college in Manchester.
example.zh: 她在曼彻斯特的一所学院学习酒店管理。

example.en: You can order the books online and collect them in store.
example.zh: 你可以在网上订购图书然后到店自取。

example.en: The police closed the road after the accident.
example.zh: 事故发生后，警察封闭了道路。

example.en: Leave your telephone number and we will call you back.
example.zh: 留下你的电话号码，我们会给你回电。

example.en: Many migrating birds stop at this lake to feed.
example.zh: 许多候鸟在这个湖边停留觅食。

example.en: The instructions on the form are clear and easy to follow.
example.zh: 表格上的说明清楚易懂。

example.en: You can hire a bicycle from the shop next to the station.
example.zh: 你可以在车站旁边的商店租一辆自行车。

example.en: The library extends its opening hours during the exam period.
example.zh: 考试期间图书馆会延长开放时间。

example.en: All students must buy medical insurance before enrolment.
example.zh: 所有学生在注册前必须购买医疗保险。

example.en: The clinic offers physical therapy for sports injuries.
example.zh: 这家诊所为运动损伤提供理疗。

example.en: Check the schedule to see when your seminar starts.
example.zh: 查一下课程表，看看你的研讨课几点开始。

example.en: Our new flatmate is an Australian studying engineering.
example.zh: 我们的新室友是一个学工程的澳大利亚人。

example.en: The British are said to talk about the weather a lot.
example.zh: 据说英国人很爱谈论天气。

example.en: Please leave your key at the reception when you go out.
example.zh: 外出时请把钥匙留在接待处。

example.en: Colds are common among students during the winter term.
example.zh: 冬季学期里感冒在学生中很常见。

example.en: We were stuck in a traffic jam for nearly an hour.
example.zh: 我们被堵在路上将近一个小时。

example.en: Take a warm jacket because the evenings can be cold.
example.zh: 带件保暖的夹克，因为晚上可能会冷。

example.en: Each student may bring one guest to the graduation ceremony.
example.zh: 每位学生可以带一名来宾参加毕业典礼。

example.en: A special feature of the course is its fieldwork component.
example.zh: 这门课程的一大特色是野外实习部分。

example.en: The speaker made an interesting point about climate change.
example.zh: 演讲者就气候变化提出了一个有趣的观点。

example.en: What color would you like for the cover of the brochure?
example.zh: 宣传册的封面你想要什么颜色？

example.en: The old church has been converted into a concert hall.
example.zh: 这座古老的教堂已被改建成音乐厅。

example.en: Let's have a short break before the next session.
example.zh: 下一节开始前我们先短暂休息一下。

example.en: In the word 'photograph', the stress falls on the first syllable.
example.zh: 在单词 photograph 中，重音落在第一个音节上。

example.en: Remember to wear comfortable shoes for the field trip.
example.zh: 记得实地考察时穿舒适的鞋子。

example.en: The guy at the information desk was really helpful.
example.zh: 问询处的那个小伙子非常热心。

example.en: The meeting will address several issues about student housing.
example.zh: 会议将讨论几个有关学生住宿的问题。

example.en: The campaign aims to raise awareness of water shortages.
example.zh: 这项活动旨在提高人们对缺水问题的意识。

example.en: Please turn off your phone before the lecture begins.
example.zh: 讲座开始前请关闭手机。

example.en: The company provides free training for all new employees.
example.zh: 公司为所有新员工提供免费培训。

example.en: Fishing is not permitted in the reservoir.
example.zh: 水库里禁止钓鱼。

example.en: The notebooks are made from recycled paper.
example.zh: 这些笔记本是用再生纸做的。

example.en: There will be a group discussion after the presentation.
example.zh: 报告结束后将进行小组讨论。

example.en: The deadline for the assignment is Friday the fifteenth.
example.zh: 作业的截止日期是十五号星期五。

example.en: The washing machines in the basement take one-pound coins.
example.zh: 地下室的洗衣机只收一英镑硬币。

example.en: Many families visit the science museum during the holidays.
example.zh: 假期里许多家庭会参观科学博物馆。

example.en: You must complete the registration form before Monday.
example.zh: 你必须在周一之前填完注册表。

example.en: Membership cards can be collected from the front desk.
example.zh: 会员卡可以到前台领取。

example.en: She hopes to do research in the field of renewable energy.
example.zh: 她希望在可再生能源领域做研究。

example.en: Many students take part-time jobs to cover living costs.
example.zh: 许多学生做兼职来支付生活费。

example.en: The town has a market every Saturday morning.
example.zh: 这个小镇每周六上午有集市。

example.en: The national park is home to a rich variety of wildlife.
example.zh: 这座国家公园栖息着种类丰富的野生动物。

example.en: A commission was set up to investigate the traffic problem.
example.zh: 成立了一个委员会来调查交通问题。

example.en: The starting salary for this position is quite competitive.
example.zh: 这个职位的起薪相当有竞争力。

example.en: The course combines theoretical study with practical training.
example.zh: 这门课程将理论学习与实践训练相结合。

example.en: If the headache continues, you should see a doctor.
example.zh: 如果头痛持续，你应该去看医生。

example.en: The old penny coins are now collectors' items.
example.zh: 旧的便士硬币如今成了收藏品。

example.en: Some insects play a vital role in pollinating crops.
example.zh: 有些昆虫在给农作物授粉方面起着重要作用。

example.en: Nurses on the night shift finish work at seven in the morning.
example.zh: 上夜班的护士早上七点下班。

example.en: Each visitor received a free sample of the new perfume.
example.zh: 每位来宾都得到了新香水的免费小样。

example.en: The museum has a fine collection of ancient Chinese pottery.
example.zh: 博物馆收藏了一批精美的中国古代陶器。

example.en: The hotel is within walking distance of the beach.
example.zh: 这家酒店距海滩步行即可到达。

example.en: The project was delayed because of a lack of funding.
example.zh: 由于缺乏资金，项目被推迟了。

example.en: Wearing a helmet gives cyclists a greater sense of safety.
example.zh: 戴头盔让骑车人更有安全感。

example.en: Take two pills after meals, three times a day.
example.zh: 每日三次，饭后服用两片药。

example.en: The final assessment consists of an essay and a presentation.
example.zh: 期末考核由一篇论文和一次报告组成。

example.en: You can exchange currency at the airport, but the rate is poor.
example.zh: 你可以在机场兑换货币，但汇率不好。

example.en: She works as a research assistant in the chemistry department.
example.zh: 她在化学系担任研究助理。

example.en: The bikes are second-hand but in very good condition.
example.zh: 这些自行车是二手的，但车况很好。

example.en: The hotel is a short distance from the railway station.
example.zh: 这家酒店离火车站不远。

example.en: You can borrow up to eight books from the library at a time.
example.zh: 你一次最多可以从图书馆借八本书。

example.en: The referee stopped the match because of the heavy rain.
example.zh: 由于大雨，裁判中止了比赛。

example.en: Reading widely is the best way to build your vocabulary.
example.zh: 广泛阅读是扩大词汇量的最佳方法。

example.en: The clinic provides professional advice on diet and exercise.
example.zh: 诊所就饮食和锻炼提供专业建议。

example.en: The city is facing a serious shortage of affordable housing.
example.zh: 这座城市正面临经济适用房严重短缺的问题。

example.en: There is no extra charge for using the swimming pool.
example.zh: 使用游泳池不额外收费。

example.en: The bank is in the central part of the city.
example.zh: 银行位于市中心地带。

example.en: Bamboo is a cheap and environmentally friendly building material.
example.zh: 竹子是一种廉价又环保的建筑材料。

example.en: Working long hours at a screen can damage your eyesight.
example.zh: 长时间盯着屏幕工作会损害视力。

example.en: The summit is about three thousand feet above sea level.
example.zh: 山顶海拔约三千英尺。

example.en: The seminar lasts an hour and a quarter.
example.zh: 研讨课持续一小时十五分钟。

example.en: Agriculture is still the dominant industry in this region.
example.zh: 农业仍是这个地区的主导产业。

example.en: Student visas must be renewed before they expire.
example.zh: 学生签证必须在到期前续签。

example.en: This term we will focus on academic writing skills.
example.zh: 这学期我们将重点学习学术写作技巧。

example.en: Regular physical exercise helps to reduce stress.
example.zh: 经常进行体育锻炼有助于减轻压力。

example.en: The sound of traffic makes it hard to study in this room.
example.zh: 车流的噪音让人很难在这个房间里学习。

example.en: The guest speaker will talk about careers in publishing.
example.zh: 特邀演讲者将谈谈出版业的职业发展。

example.en: The careers office helps students plan their future career.
example.zh: 就业指导中心帮助学生规划未来的职业。

example.en: Reference books cannot be taken out of the library.
example.zh: 参考书不能带出图书馆。

example.en: Our landlady lives on the ground floor of the house.
example.zh: 我们的房东住在这栋房子的一楼。

example.en: You need to take a placement test before choosing a class.
example.zh: 选班之前你需要参加一次分级测试。

example.en: The restaurant has a special menu for children.
example.zh: 这家餐厅有专门的儿童菜单。

example.en: It is unusual for snow to fall here in April.
example.zh: 这里四月下雪是很不寻常的。

example.en: The tutor holds a weekly meeting with each student.
example.zh: 导师每周与每个学生见一次面。

example.en: The storm cut off the power to the whole village.
example.zh: 暴风雨切断了整个村庄的电力供应。

example.en: The cave paintings are thought to be twenty thousand years old.
example.zh: 这些洞穴壁画据信有两万年的历史。

example.en: The mechanic checked the engine before the long journey.
example.zh: 长途旅行前，机械师检查了发动机。

example.en: She keeps a diary to record her progress in English.
example.zh: 她记日记来记录自己英语学习的进步。

example.en: The hospital has installed the most advanced scanning equipment.
example.zh: 这家医院安装了最先进的扫描设备。

example.en: With a bit of luck, we'll finish the project on time.
example.zh: 运气好的话，我们能按时完成这个项目。

example.en: The ancient temple attracts thousands of visitors every year.
example.zh: 这座古老的寺庙每年吸引成千上万的游客。

example.en: The northern lights are a spectacular natural phenomenon.
example.zh: 北极光是一种壮观的自然现象。

example.en: We will review the main points at the end of the lecture.
example.zh: 讲座结束时我们会复习要点。

example.en: Learning a foreign language opens up many opportunities.
example.zh: 学习一门外语会带来许多机会。

example.en: The key finding of the study was quite surprising.
example.zh: 这项研究的主要发现相当令人吃惊。

example.en: The two countries have maintained friendly relations for decades.
example.zh: 两国几十年来一直保持友好关系。

example.en: The result of the experiment supported the original theory.
example.zh: 实验结果支持了最初的理论。

example.en: The cinema gives student discounts on Tuesday evenings.
example.zh: 这家电影院周二晚上给学生打折。

example.en: France is famous for producing hundreds of kinds of cheese.
example.zh: 法国以出产数百种奶酪而闻名。

example.en: She learned to ride a horse on her uncle's farm.
example.zh: 她在叔叔的农场学会了骑马。

example.en: The aim of the course is to improve your listening skills.
example.zh: 这门课程的目的是提高你的听力技能。

example.en: This bird is now so rare that it is protected by law.
example.zh: 这种鸟现在非常罕见，受到法律保护。

example.en: Her current research deals with renewable energy.
example.zh: 她目前的研究涉及可再生能源。

example.en: He studied French for five years at secondary school.
example.zh: 他在中学学了五年法语。

example.en: Each factory worker is trained to operate the new machines.
example.zh: 每个工厂工人都接受了操作新机器的培训。

example.en: She took out a loan to pay her tuition fees.
example.zh: 她贷款支付学费。

example.en: The stores in the city centre stay open late on Fridays.
example.zh: 市中心的商场周五营业到很晚。

example.en: Forests of giant kelp grow along the cold coastline.
example.zh: 巨型海藻林沿着寒冷的海岸线生长。

example.en: The old storehouse by the harbour is now an art gallery.
example.zh: 港口旁的旧仓库现在成了美术馆。

example.en: The hens are let out of the barn every morning.
example.zh: 母鸡每天早上被放出谷仓。

example.en: This textbook is intended for intermediate learners of English.
example.zh: 这本教材是为中级英语学习者编写的。

example.en: The library website has a lot of useful study resources.
example.zh: 图书馆网站上有许多有用的学习资源。

example.zh: 岛上大部分地区被茂密的森林覆盖。

example.zh: 这片沙漠的年降水量不足五十毫米。

example.en: The wetland provides a breeding ground for many water birds.
example.zh: 这片湿地为许多水鸟提供了繁殖地。

example.zh: 遇到紧急情况请拨打校园保卫处电话。

example.zh: 毕业后她在一家银行找到了一份全职工作。

example.zh: 他小时候母亲教他做饭。

example.zh: 村庄坐落在一座高山脚下。

example.en: Some people eat less meat for environmental reasons.
example.zh: 有些人出于环保原因少吃肉。

example.zh: 一名好导游需要外向的个性。

example.zh: 如果护照丢失，你应该联系大使馆。

example.zh: 这项调查收集了年龄、性别和职业方面的数据。

example.zh: 学生宿舍的每个房间都有独立卫生间。

example.zh: 讲座涵盖了几个与气候变化相关的话题。

example.zh: 学历更高的毕业生通常收入更高。

example.zh: 政府增加了对公共图书馆的拨款。

example.zh: 开往机场的火车每十五分钟一班。

example.zh: 游泳是适合所有年龄段人群的良好锻炼方式。

example.zh: 他们租了一间海边小屋过夏天。

example.zh: 她经营着一家卖手工首饰的小公司。

example.en: He injured his left foot while playing football.
example.zh: 他踢足球时伤了左脚。

example.en: The total cost of the trip, including meals, is ninety pounds.
example.zh: 包括餐费在内，这次旅行的总费用是九十英镑。

example.en: There is a big difference between spoken and written English.
example.zh: 英语口语和书面语之间有很大差异。

example.en: Feeding the animals is the responsibility of the volunteers.
example.zh: 喂养动物是志愿者的职责。

example.en: The museum offers daily guided tours at eleven o'clock.
example.zh: 博物馆每天十一点提供导览服务。

example.en: Visual aids such as charts make a presentation clearer.
example.zh: 图表之类的视觉辅助工具能让演示更清晰。

example.en: Tennis is the most popular sport at our college.
example.zh: 网球是我们学院最受欢迎的运动。

example.en: Visitors are not allowed to take photos inside the gallery.
example.zh: 参观者不得在展馆内拍照。

example.en: The speed limit in the city centre is twenty miles per hour.
example.zh: 市中心的限速是每小时二十英里。

example.en: The university offers financial support to students in need.
example.zh: 大学为有困难的学生提供经济资助。

example.en: Local residents are angry about the new airport plan.
example.zh: 当地居民对新机场计划感到气愤。

example.en: You shouldn't judge people by their appearance.
example.zh: 你不应该以貌取人。

example.en: The old factory has been turned into student apartments.
example.zh: 这座旧工厂已被改造成学生公寓。

example.en: Scientists are studying the effects of noise on sleep.
example.zh: 科学家正在研究噪音对睡眠的影响。

example.en: Did you notice the sign on the laboratory door?
example.zh: 你注意到实验室门上的告示了吗？

example.en: The results are based on experimental data from two labs.
example.zh: 这些结果基于两个实验室的实验数据。

example.en: Light refreshment will be served after the lecture.
example.zh: 讲座结束后将提供茶点。

example.en: He served in the army for six years before going to university.
example.zh: 上大学之前他在军队服役了六年。

example.en: The village school has only about forty pupils.
example.zh: 这所乡村学校只有大约四十名学生。

example.en: Please label your food before putting it in the shared fridge.
example.zh: 把食物放进公用冰箱前请贴上标签。

example.en: The equipment is checked regularly for safety.
example.zh: 为了安全，这些设备会定期接受检查。

example.en: The original plan was changed because of the cost.
example.zh: 由于成本原因，最初的计划被修改了。

example.en: You should prepare some questions before the interview.
example.zh: 面试前你应该准备一些问题。

example.en: The lecturer uploads videos of her classes every week.
example.zh: 讲师每周上传她的课程视频。

example.en: The restaurant by the harbour is famous for its fresh seafood.
example.zh: 港口旁的这家餐厅以新鲜海鲜闻名。

example.en: Write your full address, including the postcode.
example.zh: 写下你的完整地址，包括邮编。

example.en: This region is known for its wine and olive oil.
example.zh: 这个地区以葡萄酒和橄榄油闻名。

example.en: One of the advantages of cycling is that it keeps you fit.
example.zh: 骑自行车的好处之一是能保持健康。

example.en: The story is set in the mid nineteenth century.
example.zh: 故事发生在十九世纪中叶。

example.en: You can buy a snack from the vending machine downstairs.
example.zh: 你可以在楼下的自动售货机买零食。

example.en: The library opens at eight o'clock on weekdays.
example.zh: 图书馆工作日八点开门。

example.en: There are several banks within walking distance of the campus.
example.zh: 校园步行范围内有好几家银行。

example.en: The city is famous for its ancient temples and gardens.
example.zh: 这座城市以古老的寺庙和园林闻名。

example.en: All participants in the study will remain anonymous.
example.zh: 这项研究的所有参与者都将保持匿名。

example.en: Doctors recommend at least thirty minutes of exercise a day.
example.zh: 医生建议每天至少锻炼三十分钟。

example.en: Please state your nationality on the application form.
example.zh: 请在申请表上注明你的国籍。

example.en: The supermarket no longer provides free plastic bags.
example.zh: 这家超市不再提供免费塑料袋。

example.en: The picnic area is at the northern end of the park.
example.zh: 野餐区位于公园的北端。

example.en: More than a thousand people attended the open day.
example.zh: 一千多人参加了开放日活动。

example.en: The exhibition includes photographs taken over fifty years ago.
example.zh: 展览包括五十多年前拍摄的照片。

example.en: An adult ticket costs twelve pounds, and children go half price.
example.zh: 成人票十二英镑，儿童半价。

example.en: The company moved its head office to Singapore last year.
example.zh: 这家公司去年把总部搬到了新加坡。

example.en: Plastic waste is a serious threat to ocean life.
example.zh: 塑料垃圾对海洋生物是严重的威胁。

example.en: The cabin is built entirely of local wood.
example.zh: 这间小屋完全用当地木材建造。

example.en: Cycling is becoming a popular way to get to work.
example.zh: 骑自行车正成为一种流行的通勤方式。

example.en: The first task is matching the speakers to their opinions.
example.zh: 第一项任务是将说话者与其观点配对。

example.en: The dam will supply water to three nearby cities.
example.zh: 这座大坝将为附近三座城市供水。

example.en: Show your student card to get a discount at the bookshop.
example.zh: 在书店出示学生卡可享受折扣。

example.en: Helping others is regarded as a noble act.
example.zh: 帮助他人被视为高尚的行为。

example.en: Attendance at the weekly seminar is compulsory.
example.zh: 每周的研讨课必须出席。

example.en: We play badminton in the sports hall every Thursday.
example.zh: 我们每周四在体育馆打羽毛球。

example.en: There is a direct train from the airport to the city centre.
example.zh: 有一趟从机场直达市中心的火车。

example.en: The introduction of your essay should be short and clear.
example.zh: 论文的引言应当简短清晰。

example.en: Scientists have been monitoring the glacier for thirty years.
example.zh: 科学家们对这条冰川进行了三十年的监测。

example.en: Jeans and a T-shirt are fine for the field trip.
example.zh: 实地考察穿牛仔裤和T恤就可以。

example.en: She used a voice recorder to tape the interview.
example.zh: 她用录音机录下了这次采访。

example.en: He missed the final match because of a knee injury.
example.zh: 由于膝盖受伤，他错过了决赛。

example.en: The radio station plays classical music in the evenings.
example.zh: 这家电台晚间播放古典音乐。

example.en: The student union runs a disco on Friday nights.
example.zh: 学生会每周五晚上举办迪斯科舞会。

example.en: The total cost of the course includes all materials.
example.zh: 课程的总费用包含所有材料。

example.en: She is applying to universities in the United Kingdom.
example.zh: 她正在申请英国的大学。

example.en: It is normal to feel nervous before an exam.
example.zh: 考试前感到紧张是正常的。

example.en: The theatre offers cheap tickets for students on Mondays.
example.zh: 这家剧院周一为学生提供廉价票。

example.en: Governments around the world are investing in clean energy.
example.zh: 世界各国政府都在投资清洁能源。

example.en: Fruit and vegetables are rich in fiber.
example.zh: 水果和蔬菜富含纤维。

example.en: The tribe has lived in the rainforest for centuries.
example.zh: 这个部落在雨林中生活了几个世纪。

example.en: Each parent received a report on their child's progress.
example.zh: 每位家长都收到了孩子的学习进度报告。

example.en: Hundreds of trees were planted along the new road.
example.zh: 新路两旁种了数百棵树。

example.en: The job requires good computer skills and teaching qualifications.
example.zh: 这份工作要求良好的电脑技能和教学资格。

example.en: In many cultures, people show great respect to their elders.
example.zh: 在许多文化中，人们非常尊敬长辈。

example.en: The museum's collection includes over ten thousand objects.
example.zh: 博物馆的藏品超过一万件。

example.en: The company hired a consultant to improve its marketing.
example.zh: 公司聘请了一位顾问来改进营销。

example.en: Many accidents are caused by ignorance of basic safety rules.
example.zh: 许多事故是由于不了解基本安全规则造成的。

example.en: There has been an explosion in the number of online courses.
example.zh: 在线课程的数量出现了爆炸式增长。

example.en: The students built a model of the solar system.
example.zh: 学生们制作了一个太阳系模型。

example.en: The documentary was filmed over a period of two years.
example.zh: 这部纪录片历时两年拍摄。

example.en: Poor sleeping habits can affect your concentration in class.
example.zh: 不良的睡眠习惯会影响你上课的注意力。

example.en: Please bring some form of identification, such as a passport.
example.zh: 请携带护照等身份证明。

example.en: The lecture was supported by clear visual materials.
example.zh: 讲座配有清晰的视觉材料。

example.en: Applicants for the scholarship must submit two reference letters.
example.zh: 奖学金申请者必须提交两封推荐信。

example.en: The city council has approved the plan for a new sports centre.
example.zh: 市议会批准了新建体育中心的计划。

example.en: The waiter recommended the fish of the day.
example.zh: 服务生推荐了今日鲜鱼。

example.en: Newspapers sometimes exaggerate the risks of new technology.
example.zh: 报纸有时会夸大新技术的风险。

example.en: She used her savings to pay for the study trip.
example.zh: 她用自己的积蓄支付了游学费用。

example.en: In Britain, cars drive on the left side of the road.
example.zh: 在英国，汽车靠道路左侧行驶。

example.en: Early humans made tools from stone and bone.
example.zh: 早期人类用石头和骨头制造工具。

example.en: Spending time in nature helps people relax.
example.zh: 亲近自然有助于人们放松。

example.en: The city plans to create more green spaces for residents.
example.zh: 该市计划为居民创造更多绿地。

example.en: We must use natural resources more carefully.
example.zh: 我们必须更加谨慎地利用自然资源。

example.en: Her ambition is to become a marine biologist.
example.zh: 她的抱负是成为一名海洋生物学家。

example.en: She bought a skirt and a jacket for the interview.
example.zh: 她为面试买了一条裙子和一件外套。

example.en: The thief was caught on the security cameras.
example.zh: 小偷被监控摄像头拍了下来。

example.en: The application form for the art course is pink.
example.zh: 艺术课程的申请表是粉色的。

example.en: Regular training will make your muscles stronger.
example.zh: 经常训练会让你的肌肉更强壮。

example.en: The maximum weight for hand luggage is ten kilograms.
example.zh: 手提行李的最大重量是十公斤。

example.en: A teaching qualification is required for this position.
example.zh: 这个职位需要教师资格。

example.en: The shop has a wide selection of second-hand books.
example.zh: 这家店有种类繁多的二手书可供挑选。

example.en: Safety and health are the top priorities of the project.
example.zh: 安全和健康是这个项目的首要事项。

example.en: Please put the chairs back after the seminar.
example.zh: 研讨课结束后请把椅子放回原处。

example.en: He won a scholarship to study music in Vienna.
example.zh: 他获得了去维也纳学习音乐的奖学金。

example.en: The geography class is planning a trip to the coast.
example.zh: 地理课正在筹划一次海边考察旅行。

example.en: She is taking a three-year degree course in nursing.
example.zh: 她正在攻读为期三年的护理学位课程。

example.en: The museum displays coins from ancient Rome.
example.zh: 博物馆展出古罗马的钱币。

example.en: The palace is open to visitors during the summer months.
example.zh: 宫殿在夏季对游客开放。

example.en: The photocopier charges five pence per page.
example.zh: 复印机每页收费五便士。

example.en: The garden is full of flowers in late spring.
example.zh: 暮春时节，花园里开满了鲜花。

example.en: Mandarin Chinese has four basic tones.
example.zh: 汉语普通话有四个基本声调。

example.en: Keep copies of all your important documents.
example.zh: 请保留所有重要文件的副本。

example.en: The suitcase is too heavy to carry upstairs.
example.zh: 这个箱子太重了，搬不上楼。

example.en: The main objective of the survey is to measure student satisfaction.
example.zh: 这项调查的主要目标是衡量学生满意度。

example.en: Tourism has had a big impact on the local economy.
example.zh: 旅游业对当地经济产生了很大影响。

example.en: Atmospheric pollution is worst in the city centre.
example.zh: 市中心的大气污染最为严重。

example.en: Please pay attention to the safety instructions.
example.zh: 请注意安全须知。

example.en: She writes a blog about sustainable fashion.
example.zh: 她写一个关于可持续时尚的博客。

example.en: The team won the silver medal in the relay race.
example.zh: 该队在接力赛中获得了银牌。

example.en: Vaccines have wiped out several serious diseases.
example.zh: 疫苗已经消灭了几种严重的疾病。

example.en: This medicine may cause drowsiness, so do not drive.
example.zh: 这种药可能引起困倦，服药后请勿驾车。

example.en: She works as a volunteer at the animal shelter on weekends.
example.zh: 她周末在动物收容所做志愿者。

example.en: Modern technology has changed the way we learn languages.
example.zh: 现代科技改变了我们学习语言的方式。

example.en: The professor has done extensive research on coral reefs.
example.zh: 这位教授对珊瑚礁做过广泛的研究。

example.en: The city is famous for its medieval architecture.
example.zh: 这座城市以中世纪建筑闻名。

example.en: She teaches in the Faculty of Engineering.
example.zh: 她在工程学院任教。

example.en: Please put your bag in the overhead locker.
example.zh: 请把包放进头顶的行李柜。

example.en: The rapid growth of cities creates housing problems.
example.zh: 城市的快速发展带来了住房问题。

example.en: The language lab still keeps some old cassettes.
example.zh: 语音室还保留着一些旧磁带。

example.en: Wash the cut carefully to prevent infection.
example.zh: 仔细清洗伤口以防感染。

example.en: The project succeeded thanks to close cooperation between the two teams.
example.zh: 由于两个团队的密切合作，项目取得了成功。

example.en: A mosquito net will protect you while you sleep.
example.zh: 蚊帐能在你睡觉时保护你。

example.en: The last train to the city leaves at half past eleven.
example.zh: 去市区的末班火车十一点半发车。

example.en: The processing of visa applications takes about three weeks.
example.zh: 签证申请的处理大约需要三周。

example.en: New students take a placement test in the first week.
example.zh: 新生在第一周参加分班测试。

example.en: Few people are aware of how much water they waste.
example.zh: 很少有人意识到自己浪费了多少水。

example.en: The panda is perhaps the most famous animal in China.
example.zh: 熊猫也许是中国最有名的动物。

example.en: You need to write a formal letter to apply for the job.
example.zh: 申请这份工作你需要写一封正式信函。

example.en: Clean sheets are provided every week in the hall of residence.
example.zh: 学生宿舍每周提供干净的床单。

example.en: Tell the doctor if you are allergic to penicillin.
example.zh: 如果你对青霉素过敏，请告诉医生。

example.en: The new sports centre has a pool and two gyms.
example.zh: 新体育中心有一个游泳池和两个健身房。

example.en: Crocodiles can stay underwater for more than an hour.
example.zh: 鳄鱼可以在水下待一个多小时。

example.en: The welcome party starts with a cocktail reception.
example.zh: 欢迎会以鸡尾酒会开场。

example.en: Breakfast is served in the dining hall from seven to nine.
example.zh: 早餐七点到九点在餐厅供应。

example.en: Good study habits are formed through daily practice.
example.zh: 良好的学习习惯是通过日常练习养成的。

example.en: The study examines the feeding behavior of wild dolphins.
example.zh: 这项研究考察野生海豚的进食行为。

example.en: He plays the guitar in a student band.
example.zh: 他在一支学生乐队里弹吉他。

example.en: The identities of the interviewees were kept secret.
example.zh: 受访者的身份被保密。

example.en: Students from neighboring towns travel here by bus.
example.zh: 邻近城镇的学生乘公交车来这里上学。

example.en: The picture on page ten shows the water cycle.
example.zh: 第十页的图展示了水循环。

example.en: Her speech about volunteering was truly inspiring.
example.zh: 她关于志愿服务的演讲十分鼓舞人心。

example.en: Rising sea levels threaten many coastal cities.
example.zh: 不断上升的海平面威胁着许多沿海城市。

example.en: A printed copy of the timetable is available at reception.
example.zh: 接待处可领取印刷版时间表。

example.en: Free brochures about the city are available at the tourist office.
example.zh: 旅游咨询处提供免费的城市宣传册。

example.en: She has published several papers on child language learning.
example.zh: 她发表了几篇关于儿童语言学习的论文。

example.en: The report looks at recent trends in online shopping.
example.zh: 这份报告考察了网络购物的最新趋势。

example.en: There are no extra charges for cancelling your booking.
example.zh: 取消预订不收取额外费用。

example.en: The content of the course changes slightly every year.
example.zh: 课程内容每年都会略有变化。

example.en: The maximum number of students per class is fifteen.
example.zh: 每班学生人数最多十五人。

example.en: The library offers a wide range of electronic journals.
example.zh: 图书馆提供种类繁多的电子期刊。

example.en: She trained as a lawyer before becoming a writer.
example.zh: 成为作家之前，她受过律师训练。

example.en: Some students have difficulty adapting to life abroad.
example.zh: 一些学生难以适应国外的生活。

example.en: The fitness centre is open until ten every night.
example.zh: 健身中心每晚开放到十点。

example.en: She is studying English literature at Leeds University.
example.zh: 她在利兹大学攻读英国文学。

example.en: The conclusion should summarise your main arguments.
example.zh: 结论部分应概括你的主要论点。

example.en: He taught geography at a secondary school for ten years.
example.zh: 他在一所中学教了十年地理。

example.en: The story first appeared in a local newspaper.
example.zh: 这则报道最早刊登在当地一家报纸上。

example.en: The house has a garage big enough for two cars.
example.zh: 这栋房子的车库能停两辆车。

example.en: The final chapter presents an analysis of the survey data.
example.zh: 最后一章对调查数据进行了分析。

example.en: Make sure you are familiar with the exam format.
example.zh: 确保你熟悉考试的形式。

example.en: The cop asked to see the driver's licence.
example.zh: 警察要求查看司机的驾照。

example.en: He lost his temper when the flight was cancelled again.
example.zh: 航班再次被取消时，他发了脾气。

example.en: Passengers should keep their luggage with them at all times.
example.zh: 乘客应随时随身携带行李。

example.en: Remember to list all your sources at the end of the essay.
example.zh: 记得在论文末尾列出所有资料来源。

example.en: The introduction gives a brief history of the museum.
example.zh: 简介部分简要介绍了博物馆的历史。

example.en: Global warming is causing glaciers to melt faster.
example.zh: 全球变暖正使冰川加速融化。

example.en: Bees play a key role in producing our food.
example.zh: 蜜蜂在粮食生产中扮演着关键角色。

example.en: The United States consists of fifty states.
example.zh: 美国由五十个州组成。

example.en: Hand in your lab report by Friday afternoon.
example.zh: 请在周五下午之前提交实验报告。

example.en: The objectives of the course are listed in the handbook.
example.zh: 课程目标列在手册里。

example.en: Please read the safety rules before entering the laboratory.
example.zh: 进入实验室前请阅读安全规则。

example.en: The guidebook lists the best places to watch birds.
example.zh: 这本指南列出了观鸟的最佳地点。

example.en: She joined the student film association in her first year.
example.zh: 她在大一时加入了学生电影协会。

example.en: Farmers here grow crops such as wheat and barley.
example.zh: 这里的农民种植小麦和大麦等庄稼。

example.en: Please fill in your personal details on the first page.
example.zh: 请在第一页填写你的个人信息。

example.en: His girlfriend is studying medicine in Edinburgh.
example.zh: 他的女朋友在爱丁堡学医。

example.en: The gym's instructors can design a training plan for you.
example.zh: 健身房的教练可以为你制定训练计划。

example.en: Take the lift to the fifth floor and turn left.
example.zh: 乘电梯到五楼然后左转。

example.en: Teaching young children is a challenging but rewarding job.
example.zh: 教幼儿是一份有挑战性但很有意义的工作。

example.en: A double room with a sea view costs more.
example.zh: 海景双人间价格更高。

example.en: He travelled across the country by motorcycle.
example.zh: 他骑摩托车穿越了全国。

example.en: The region is known for the cultivation of rice.
example.zh: 这个地区以种植水稻闻名。

example.en: Most graduates of this course find jobs within six months.
example.zh: 这门课程的大多数毕业生在半年内找到工作。

example.en: Moving to the countryside completely changed their lifestyle.
example.zh: 搬到乡下彻底改变了他们的生活方式。

example.en: Her hobbies include photography and rock climbing.
example.zh: 她的爱好包括摄影和攀岩。

example.en: The new mall attracts thousands of shoppers every weekend.
example.zh: 新商场每个周末吸引成千上万的购物者。

example.en: The internship helped her build useful contacts in the industry.
example.zh: 这次实习帮她在业内建立了有用的人脉。

example.en: The spring semester begins in early February.
example.zh: 春季学期二月初开始。

example.en: Owls have excellent sight in low light.
example.zh: 猫头鹰在暗光下视力极佳。

example.en: Much of the land near the river is used for farming.
example.zh: 河边的大部分土地用于耕作。

example.en: Rich soil makes this valley ideal for growing vegetables.
example.zh: 肥沃的土壤使这个山谷非常适合种菜。

example.en: Television commercials strongly influence children's food choices.
example.zh: 电视广告强烈影响儿童的食品选择。

example.en: The computer room stays open until midnight during exams.
example.zh: 考试期间机房开放到午夜。

example.en: You need to transfer to the Northern Line at King's Cross.
example.zh: 你需要在国王十字站换乘北线。

example.en: One of the benefits of the job is free travel.
example.zh: 这份工作的好处之一是免费旅行。

example.en: The university has clubs for everything from chess to sailing.
example.zh: 大学里从国际象棋到帆船的社团应有尽有。

example.en: The insurance does not cover damage to bicycles.
example.zh: 这份保险不涵盖自行车的损坏。

example.en: There is a drop-off point for taxis outside the terminal.
example.zh: 航站楼外设有出租车下客点。

example.en: The brochure contains pictures of all the guest rooms.
example.zh: 宣传册里有所有客房的图片。

example.en: Research on artificial intelligence is advancing rapidly.
example.zh: 人工智能研究正在迅速发展。

example.en: The museum runs educational programmes for school groups.
example.zh: 博物馆为学校团体开设教育项目。

example.en: The teacher introduced a new method for memorising words.
example.zh: 老师介绍了一种记单词的新方法。

example.en: Her study was published in a leading science journal.
example.zh: 她的研究发表在一本顶尖科学期刊上。

example.en: The organizer of the conference booked a larger hall.
example.zh: 会议组织者预订了一个更大的会场。

example.en: He works as a software engineer for a startup.
example.zh: 他在一家初创公司担任软件工程师。

example.en: The country's main export is coffee.
example.zh: 这个国家的主要出口产品是咖啡。

example.en: Don't forget to register for the conference before May.
example.zh: 别忘了在五月前注册参加会议。

example.en: Many students graduate with a large debt.
example.zh: 许多学生毕业时背负着巨额债务。

example.en: The company changed its strategy to attract younger customers.
example.zh: 公司改变策略以吸引更年轻的顾客。

example.en: The instructions are simple enough for anyone to follow.
example.zh: 这些说明简单易懂，任何人都能照做。

example.en: Bring a warm sweater because the evenings get cold.
example.zh: 带件暖和的毛衣，因为晚上会变冷。

example.en: It would be wise to book your accommodation early.
example.zh: 尽早预订住宿是明智的。

example.en: Swimming here is dangerous because of the strong currents.
example.zh: 由于水流湍急，在这里游泳很危险。

example.en: The report examines the causes of traffic congestion.
example.zh: 这份报告考察了交通拥堵的原因。

example.en: After retirement, he took up painting as a hobby.
example.zh: 退休后，他把绘画当作爱好。

example.en: A small amount of stress can actually improve performance.
example.zh: 适量的压力其实能提高表现。

example.en: You should brush your teeth at least twice a day.
example.zh: 你每天应该至少刷两次牙。

example.en: The company launched a new product last month.
example.zh: 公司上个月推出了一款新产品。

example.en: New students receive guidance on choosing their courses.
example.zh: 新生在选课方面会得到指导。

example.en: The average temperature here in July is twenty-five degrees.
example.zh: 这里七月的平均气温是二十五度。

example.en: Free parking is available behind the main building.
example.zh: 主楼后面有免费停车场。

example.en: The head of department gave a short speech at the ceremony.
example.zh: 系主任在典礼上作了简短的演讲。

example.en: The city offers plenty of entertainment, from cinemas to concerts.
example.zh: 这座城市娱乐活动丰富，从电影院到音乐会应有尽有。

example.en: The population of the town has doubled in twenty years.
example.zh: 这个镇的人口在二十年里翻了一番。

example.en: She is studying medicine and wants to become a surgeon.
example.zh: 她在学医，想成为一名外科医生。

example.en: In biology we studied how plants convert sunlight into energy.
example.zh: 生物课上我们学习了植物如何将阳光转化为能量。

example.en: The chemistry lab is on the third floor of the science building.
example.zh: 化学实验室在科学楼三层。

example.en: He finds physics difficult but fascinating.
example.zh: 他觉得物理很难但很迷人。

example.en: A good grade in mathematics is required for this course.
example.zh: 这门课程要求数学成绩优良。

example.en: In geography we learned how rivers shape the landscape.
example.zh: 地理课上我们学习了河流如何塑造地貌。

example.en: Psychology explores how people think, feel and behave.
example.zh: 心理学探究人们如何思考、感受和行动。

example.en: Her sociology essay examines how cities change family life.
example.zh: 她的社会学论文考察城市如何改变家庭生活。

example.en: He switched from economics to environmental science in his second year.
example.zh: 他在大二时从经济学转到了环境科学。

example.en: Philosophy teaches you to question your own assumptions.
example.zh: 哲学教你质疑自己的假设。

example.en: Civil engineering involves designing bridges, roads and dams.
example.zh: 土木工程涉及桥梁、道路和大坝的设计。

example.en: The experiment was designed to test the hypothesis.
example.zh: 这个实验是为了验证该假说而设计的。

example.en: Modern agriculture depends heavily on irrigation.
example.zh: 现代农业在很大程度上依赖灌溉。

example.en: Tourism is the island's main source of income.
example.zh: 旅游业是这座岛的主要收入来源。

example.en: Computer skills are now part of the school curriculum.
example.zh: 计算机技能现在是学校课程体系的一部分。

example.en: Tuition fees for overseas students rose again this year.
example.zh: 海外学生的学费今年再次上涨。

example.en: I'd like to make a reservation for two nights next week.
example.zh: 我想预订下周的两晚住宿。

example.en: The island is a popular destination for honeymoon couples.
example.zh: 这座岛是蜜月旅行的热门目的地。

example.en: Please arrive at the airport two hours before departure.
example.zh: 请在起飞前两小时到达机场。

example.en: On arrival, all guests receive a welcome pack.
example.zh: 所有客人到达时都会收到一份欢迎礼包。

example.en: The train journey from here to the coast takes three hours.
example.zh: 从这里到海边的火车旅程需要三个小时。

example.en: The voyage across the Atlantic took ten days.
example.zh: 横渡大西洋的航行花了十天。

example.en: The trip to the rainforest was a real adventure.
example.zh: 这次雨林之行是一次真正的冒险。

example.en: She is writing her thesis on renewable energy policy.
example.zh: 她正在写关于可再生能源政策的学位论文。

example.en: A good guide needs detailed knowledge of local history.
example.zh: 一名好导游需要对当地历史有详尽的了解。

example.en: The lab is open to undergraduate students on weekdays.
example.zh: 实验室在工作日向本科生开放。

example.en: She is doing a postgraduate degree in linguistics.
example.zh: 她正在攻读语言学研究生学位。

example.en: She showed a talent for languages at an early age.
example.zh: 她很小就展现出语言天赋。

example.en: Winning the scholarship was her proudest achievement.
example.zh: 获得奖学金是她最自豪的成就。

example.en: The success of the project depends on careful planning.
example.zh: 项目的成功取决于周密的计划。

example.en: The syllabus lists all the topics covered this term.
example.zh: 教学大纲列出了本学期的所有主题。

example.en: Writing a thesis in a second language is a real challenge.
example.zh: 用第二语言写论文是一项真正的挑战。

example.en: The internship is a great opportunity to gain work experience.
example.zh: 这次实习是获得工作经验的绝佳机会。

example.en: There is a strong possibility of rain this afternoon.
example.zh: 今天下午很可能下雨。

example.en: The probability of winning the lottery is extremely low.
example.zh: 中彩票的概率极低。

example.en: We can say with certainty that the climate is changing.
example.zh: 我们可以肯定地说气候正在变化。

example.en: Economic uncertainty makes companies cautious about hiring.
example.zh: 经济的不确定性使公司在招聘上很谨慎。

example.en: The dissertation must be handed in by the end of May.
example.zh: 毕业论文必须在五月底前提交。

example.en: There is little doubt that exercise improves health.
example.zh: 锻炼能改善健康，这一点几乎毫无疑问。

example.en: It is his belief that everyone can learn to draw.
example.zh: 他相信每个人都能学会画画。

example.en: In my opinion, the city needs more cycle paths.
example.zh: 在我看来，这座城市需要更多自行车道。

example.en: A positive attitude helps you cope with exam stress.
example.zh: 积极的态度帮助你应对考试压力。

example.en: The university uses software to detect plagiarism.
example.zh: 这所大学使用软件检测抄袭。

example.en: Travelling alone helped shape her independent character.
example.zh: 独自旅行塑造了她独立的性格。

example.en: Music is a powerful way to express emotion.
example.zh: 音乐是表达情感的有力方式。

example.en: I had a feeling that the lecture had been cancelled.
example.zh: 我有种预感，讲座被取消了。

example.en: Sunny weather always puts me in a good mood.
example.zh: 晴朗的天气总能让我心情愉快。

example.en: Her passion for wildlife led her to study zoology.
example.zh: 她对野生动物的热爱使她选择了动物学。

example.en: The new coach brought great enthusiasm to the team.
example.zh: 新教练给球队带来了极大的热情。

example.en: Clear goals can increase your motivation to study.
example.zh: 明确的目标能增强你学习的动力。

example.en: The designer found inspiration in traditional Japanese art.
example.zh: 这位设计师从日本传统艺术中找到了灵感。

example.en: Painting classes encourage creativity in young children.
example.zh: 绘画课能激发幼儿的创造力。

example.en: Reading novels is a great way to develop your imagination.
example.zh: 读小说是培养想象力的好方法。

example.en: The company is famous for innovation in electric cars.
example.zh: 这家公司以电动汽车领域的创新闻名。

example.en: The invention of the printing press changed education forever.
example.zh: 印刷机的发明永远改变了教育。

example.en: The discovery of penicillin saved millions of lives.
example.zh: 青霉素的发现拯救了数百万人的生命。

example.en: Space exploration requires enormous investment.
example.zh: 太空探索需要巨额投资。

example.en: The police carried out a thorough investigation of the incident.
example.zh: 警方对这起事件进行了彻底调查。

example.en: Her research focuses on how children learn to read.
example.zh: 她的研究关注儿童如何学习阅读。

example.en: Safety goggles must be worn in the laboratory.
example.zh: 在实验室里必须佩戴护目镜。

example.en: The course ends with an evaluation of each student's progress.
example.zh: 课程结束时会对每个学生的进步进行评估。

example.en: Please complete the questionnaire before you leave.
example.zh: 离开前请填写这份问卷。

example.en: The final examination covers everything taught this term.
example.zh: 期末考试涵盖本学期讲授的全部内容。

example.en: Enrolment for evening classes closes on Friday.
example.zh: 晚间课程的注册周五截止。

example.en: The teacher gives a vocabulary quiz every Friday.
example.zh: 老师每周五进行一次词汇小测验。

example.en: New students attend an orientation week before lectures begin.
example.zh: 新生在开课前参加为期一周的迎新活动。

example.en: She finishes her homework before dinner every day.
example.zh: 她每天晚饭前完成家庭作业。

example.en: We discuss the week's reading in a small tutorial group.
example.zh: 我们在小型辅导课上讨论本周的阅读材料。

example.en: Each student gives a ten-minute presentation at the end of term.
example.zh: 每个学生在期末做十分钟的演示报告。

example.en: The lecture on climate change attracted a large audience.
example.zh: 关于气候变化的讲座吸引了大批听众。

example.en: The opening ceremony will be held in the main auditorium.
example.zh: 开幕式将在大礼堂举行。

example.en: The writing workshop helps students improve their essays.
example.zh: 写作工作坊帮助学生改进论文。

example.en: She presented her findings at an international conference.
example.zh: 她在一次国际会议上展示了自己的研究成果。

example.en: The next staff meeting is scheduled for Tuesday morning.
example.zh: 下一次员工会议定于周二上午举行。

example.en: I have an appointment with my tutor at three o'clock.
example.zh: 我三点钟和导师有个约谈。

example.en: She felt confident after her interview for the scholarship.
example.zh: 奖学金面试之后她感觉很有信心。

example.en: We had a long conversation about life in Australia.
example.zh: 我们就澳大利亚的生活聊了很久。

example.en: Practise the dialogue with a partner before class.
example.zh: 课前和同伴练习这段对话。

example.en: The canteen serves hot meals until eight in the evening.
example.zh: 食堂供应热餐直到晚上八点。

example.en: The class held a debate on banning cars from the city centre.
example.zh: 全班就市中心禁行汽车举行了一场辩论。

example.en: The author's main argument is supported by strong evidence.
example.zh: 作者的主要论点有有力的证据支持。

example.en: There was some disagreement about where to hold the event.
example.zh: 关于活动地点存在一些分歧。

example.en: The two sides finally reached an agreement on the price.
example.zh: 双方最终就价格达成了一致。

example.en: After hours of discussion, the committee reached a consensus.
example.zh: 经过数小时讨论，委员会达成了共识。

example.en: First-year students usually live in a dormitory on campus.
example.zh: 一年级学生通常住在校内宿舍。

example.en: The project is a collaboration between two universities.
example.zh: 这个项目是两所大学之间的协作。

example.en: The museum formed a partnership with local schools.
example.zh: 博物馆与当地学校建立了伙伴关系。

example.en: She did a summer internship at a publishing company.
example.zh: 她在一家出版公司做了暑期实习。

example.en: Their friendship began in the first week of university.
example.zh: 他们的友谊始于大学的第一周。

example.en: Many elderly people keep pets for companionship.
example.zh: 许多老年人养宠物作伴。

example.en: Researchers found a connection between diet and sleep quality.
example.zh: 研究人员发现饮食与睡眠质量之间存在联系。

example.en: He holds a diploma in graphic design.
example.zh: 他持有平面设计文凭。

example.en: The app encourages interaction between learners around the world.
example.zh: 这款应用鼓励世界各地学习者之间的互动。

example.en: The two universities run a student exchange programme.
example.zh: 这两所大学开展学生交换项目。

example.en: The sharing of lecture notes is encouraged in this course.
example.zh: 这门课程鼓励分享课堂笔记。

example.en: The charity oversees the distribution of food to the villages.
example.zh: 慈善机构负责向村庄分发食物。

example.en: The allocation of rooms is done on a first-come, first-served basis.
example.zh: 房间按先到先得的原则分配。

example.en: The seating arrangement for the ceremony has been changed.
example.zh: 典礼的座位安排已经调整。

example.en: She joined a student organization that protects the environment.
example.zh: 她加入了一个保护环境的学生组织。

example.en: The essay needs a clearer structure with linked paragraphs.
example.zh: 这篇文章需要更清晰的结构和衔接的段落。

example.en: The city's underground system carries millions of passengers daily.
example.zh: 这座城市的地铁系统每天运送数百万乘客。

example.en: The administration office handles all student records.
example.zh: 行政办公室管理所有学生档案。

example.en: The professor takes a practical approach to teaching grammar.
example.zh: 这位教授采用实用的方法教语法。

example.en: The campus has excellent sports facilities.
example.zh: 校园里有一流的体育设施。

example.en: The potter demonstrated an ancient glazing technique.
example.zh: 陶艺师演示了一种古老的上釉技术。

example.en: Follow the standard procedure when reporting an accident.
example.zh: 报告事故时请遵循标准程序。

example.en: The application process takes about four weeks.
example.zh: 申请过程大约需要四周。

example.en: My tutor was pleased with the progress I had made.
example.zh: 导师对我取得的进步很满意。

example.en: The development of the port brought jobs to the town.
example.zh: 港口的发展给小镇带来了就业机会。

example.en: There has been a clear improvement in her pronunciation.
example.zh: 她的发音有了明显的进步。

example.en: The advancement of medical technology has extended human life.
example.zh: 医疗技术的进步延长了人类的寿命。

example.en: The museum traces the evolution of the bicycle.
example.zh: 博物馆展示了自行车的演变历程。

example.en: The industrial revolution completely changed working life.
example.zh: 工业革命彻底改变了劳动生活。

example.en: The old harbour has undergone a complete transformation.
example.zh: 旧港口经历了彻底的改造。

example.en: There has been a change in the timetable for next week.
example.zh: 下周的时间表有变动。

example.en: The plan needs only a small modification before approval.
example.zh: 这个方案只需稍作修改即可获批。

example.en: Moving abroad requires a period of adjustment.
example.zh: 移居国外需要一段适应期。

example.en: The camel's adaptation to desert life is remarkable.
example.zh: 骆驼对沙漠生活的适应能力令人惊叹。

example.en: Online courses give students greater flexibility.
example.zh: 在线课程给学生更大的灵活性。

example.en: Political stability attracts foreign investment.
example.zh: 政治稳定吸引外国投资。

example.en: It is hard to keep a balance between study and part-time work.
example.zh: 在学习和兼职之间保持平衡很难。

example.en: The design blends in harmony with the surrounding landscape.
example.zh: 这个设计与周围景观和谐相融。

example.en: There is often a conflict between development and conservation.
example.zh: 发展与保护之间常常存在冲突。

example.en: You could feel the tension in the room before the results were announced.
example.zh: 结果公布前，房间里的紧张气氛显而易见。

example.en: Students often feel under pressure to get high grades.
example.zh: 学生常常感到取得高分的压力。

example.en: Set up the apparatus exactly as shown in the diagram.
example.zh: 严格按照图示安装仪器。

example.en: Deep breathing can reduce anxiety before an exam.
example.zh: 深呼吸可以减轻考前焦虑。

example.en: There is no need to worry about the interview.
example.zh: 不必为面试担心。

example.en: The main concern of parents is their children's safety online.
example.zh: 家长最关注的是孩子的网络安全。

example.en: Members receive a ten-pound voucher for the campus bookshop.
example.zh: 会员可获得一张十英镑的校园书店代金券。

example.en: You can get a full refund if you cancel within a week.
example.zh: 一周内取消可获得全额退款。

example.en: Keep the receipt in case you want to exchange the item.
example.zh: 保留收据以便日后换货。

example.en: Lack of sleep affects memory and concentration.
example.zh: 睡眠不足会影响记忆力和注意力。

example.en: Her dedication to teaching earned her a national award.
example.zh: 她对教学的奉献为她赢得了国家级奖项。

example.en: Learning an instrument requires long-term commitment.
example.zh: 学习乐器需要长期的投入。

example.en: His devotion to the research project impressed his colleagues.
example.zh: 他对研究项目的专注令同事们钦佩。

example.en: The airline rewards customer loyalty with free flights.
example.zh: 这家航空公司用免费机票回馈忠实顾客。

example.en: Honesty is essential in academic writing.
example.zh: 诚实在学术写作中至关重要。

example.en: The judge was respected for her integrity.
example.zh: 这位法官因正直而受到尊敬。

example.en: The novel raises questions about science and morality.
example.zh: 这部小说提出了关于科学与道德的问题。

example.en: Medical research must follow strict ethics guidelines.
example.zh: 医学研究必须遵循严格的伦理准则。

example.en: Treating everyone fairly is a basic principle of the school.
example.zh: 公平对待每个人是这所学校的基本原则。

example.en: The training course offers good value for money.
example.zh: 这门培训课程物有所值。

example.zh: 老师强调了定期复习的重要性。

example.zh: 这一发现对癌症研究具有重大意义。

example.zh: 这个词的含义取决于上下文。

example.en: Travel insurance covers lost luggage and medical costs.
example.zh: 旅行保险涵盖行李丢失和医疗费用。

example.en: Her goal is to get a band seven in IELTS.
example.zh: 她的目标是雅思考到七分。

example.zh: 奖学金包含每月的书籍津贴。

example.zh: 慈善机构设定了筹款五万英镑的目标。

example.zh: 制定每周预算来管理生活开支。

example.zh: 许多年轻人都怀有出国留学的愿望。

example.zh: 她强烈渴望去看看世界。

example.zh: 我希望毕业后回到家乡。

example.en: There is still hope that the missing paintings will be found.
example.zh: 找回失踪画作仍有希望。

example.zh: 这部电影没有达到我的期望。

example.en: The students waited in anticipation for their results.
example.zh: 学生们满怀期待地等待成绩。

example.zh: 地震预测仍然极其困难。

example.zh: 天气预报说整个周末都是晴天。

example.en: This is only a rough estimation of the total cost.
example.zh: 这只是对总成本的粗略估计。

example.en: A small error in the calculation changed the whole result.
example.zh: 计算中的一个小错误改变了整个结果。

example.en: Accurate measurement is essential in any experiment.
example.zh: 准确的测量在任何实验中都至关重要。

example.en: A large quantity of plastic waste ends up in the sea.
example.zh: 大量塑料垃圾最终流入海洋。

example.en: Accommodation is the biggest expense for most students.
example.zh: 住宿是大多数学生最大的开支。

example.en: The number of overseas students has risen sharply.
example.zh: 海外学生的数量急剧上升。

example.en: The latest sales figures show a steady increase.
example.zh: 最新的销售数字显示稳步增长。

example.en: This statistic shows how quickly the city is growing.
example.zh: 这一统计数字显示了这座城市发展的速度。

example.en: The data was collected from over two thousand households.
example.zh: 这些数据是从两千多户家庭收集来的。

example.en: More information about the course is available online.
example.zh: 关于这门课程的更多信息可在网上查询。

example.en: Please check every detail before submitting the form.
example.zh: 提交表格前请核对每一个细节。

example.en: Pay particular attention to the spelling of names.
example.zh: 请特别注意姓名的拼写。

example.en: The teacher gave specific instructions for the assignment.
example.zh: 老师对作业给出了具体的要求。

example.en: Please give the precise time of your arrival.
example.zh: 请提供你到达的精确时间。

example.en: Nobody knows the exact age of the ancient monument.
example.zh: 没有人知道这座古代遗迹的确切年代。

example.en: Make sure your references are accurate and complete.
example.zh: 确保你的参考文献准确完整。

example.en: Choose the correct answer from the four options.
example.zh: 从四个选项中选出正确答案。

example.en: Turn right at the traffic lights and the bank is on your left.
example.zh: 在红绿灯处右转，银行就在你左手边。

example.en: Please wear proper safety equipment in the workshop.
example.zh: 在车间里请穿戴适当的安全装备。

example.en: Jeans are not appropriate for a formal interview.
example.zh: 牛仔裤不适合正式面试的场合。

example.en: The film is suitable for children of all ages.
example.zh: 这部电影适合所有年龄段的儿童观看。

example.en: Regular jogging keeps him fit and energetic.
example.zh: 经常慢跑使他保持健康和活力。

example.en: Match each speaker with the correct opinion.
example.zh: 将每位说话者与正确的观点配对。

example.en: The written figures should correspond with the totals in the table.
example.zh: 书面数字应与表格中的总数相对应。

example.en: The second lecture relates closely to the first one.
example.zh: 第二场讲座与第一场紧密相关。

example.en: A new bridge will connect the island to the mainland.
example.zh: 一座新桥将把岛屿与大陆连接起来。

example.en: Studies link regular exercise to better mental health.
example.zh: 研究表明经常锻炼与更好的心理健康有关联。

example.en: Please attach a recent photo to your application.
example.zh: 请在申请表上附上一张近照。

example.en: You can join the film club at the freshers' fair.
example.zh: 你可以在迎新会上加入电影社。

example.en: The course combines classroom study with work experience.
example.zh: 这门课程将课堂学习与工作实践相结合。

example.en: The two small colleges will merge into one next year.
example.zh: 这两所小型学院明年将合并为一所。

example.en: The campaign united students from different departments.
example.zh: 这次活动把不同院系的学生联合了起来。

example.en: The new software integrates all the library services.
example.zh: 新软件整合了图书馆的所有服务。

example.en: The final design incorporates suggestions from residents.
example.zh: 最终设计纳入了居民的建议。

example.en: The course fees include all books and materials.
example.zh: 课程费用包括所有书籍和材料。

example.en: Some energy drinks contain a lot of caffeine.
example.zh: 有些能量饮料含有大量咖啡因。

example.en: The exam comprises four papers: listening, reading, writing and speaking.
example.zh: 考试由听、读、写、说四部分组成。

example.en: The committee consists of two teachers and five students.
example.zh: 委员会由两名教师和五名学生组成。

example.en: Women compose about sixty percent of the workforce here.
example.zh: 这里的员工大约百分之六十由女性组成。

example.en: Women constitute the majority of nursing students.
example.zh: 女性构成了护理专业学生的大多数。

example.en: Part-time work gives students a small extra income.
example.zh: 兼职工作给学生带来一小笔额外收入。

example.en: The project will create hundreds of new jobs.
example.zh: 这个项目将创造数百个新的就业岗位。

example.en: The region produces most of the country's olive oil.
example.zh: 该地区生产全国大部分的橄榄油。

example.en: Wind turbines generate electricity for the whole island.
example.zh: 风力涡轮机为全岛发电。

example.en: The company plans to develop a new language-learning app.
example.zh: 这家公司计划开发一款新的语言学习应用。

example.en: They plan to build a footbridge across the river.
example.zh: 他们计划在河上建一座人行桥。

example.en: The Romans constructed roads that are still visible today.
example.zh: 罗马人修建的道路至今仍可看到。

example.en: The college was established more than a century ago.
example.zh: 这所学院建立于一百多年前。

example.en: The museum was founded by a wealthy local merchant.
example.zh: 这座博物馆由当地一位富商创立。

example.en: The examiners set a strict time limit for each task.
example.zh: 考官为每项任务设定了严格的时间限制。

example.en: The travel agent will arrange the hotel and flights for you.
example.zh: 旅行社会为你安排酒店和航班。

example.en: The students helped organize the charity concert.
example.zh: 学生们帮忙组织了慈善音乐会。

example.en: We need to plan the field trip well in advance.
example.zh: 我们需要提前把实地考察计划好。

example.en: The new library was designed by a famous architect.
example.zh: 新图书馆由一位著名建筑师设计。

example.en: The job offers a good salary and long holidays.
example.zh: 这份工作薪水不错，假期也长。

example.en: The results will be ready by the end of the week.
example.zh: 结果将在本周末前出来。

example.en: Free maps are available at the tourist information centre.
example.zh: 旅游信息中心可免费领取地图。

example.en: The museum is fully accessible to wheelchair users.
example.zh: 这座博物馆对轮椅使用者完全无障碍。

example.en: The report is obtainable from the department office.
example.zh: 这份报告可从系办公室获取。

example.en: Students acquire practical skills through laboratory work.
example.zh: 学生通过实验室工作获得实践技能。

example.en: You must obtain permission before recording the lecture.
example.zh: 录制讲座前必须获得许可。

example.en: The internship helped her gain valuable experience.
example.zh: 实习帮助她获得了宝贵的经验。

example.en: She worked hard to achieve her dream of studying abroad.
example.zh: 她努力奋斗，实现了出国留学的梦想。

example.en: The team accomplished the survey in just two weeks.
example.zh: 团队仅用两周就完成了调查。

example.en: The minimum wage was raised at the start of the year.
example.zh: 最低工资在年初上调了。

example.en: Please finish the reading before the next seminar.
example.zh: 请在下次研讨课前读完材料。

example.en: The report concludes that recycling rates must improve.
example.zh: 报告的结论是回收率必须提高。

example.en: The lecture will end at half past four.
example.zh: 讲座将在四点半结束。

example.en: The company decided to terminate the contract early.
example.zh: 公司决定提前终止合同。

example.en: The factory will cease production at the end of the year.
example.zh: 这家工厂将在年底停产。

example.en: The bus stops right outside the university gate.
example.zh: 公交车就停在大学门口。

example.en: Work on the site came to a halt when ancient coins were found.
example.zh: 发现古钱币后，工地的施工暂停了。

example.en: Let's pause the video and discuss what we have seen.
example.zh: 我们暂停视频，讨论一下刚才看到的内容。

example.en: Please don't interrupt the speaker during the presentation.
example.zh: 演讲期间请不要打断发言人。

example.en: Noise from the building site disturbs the students.
example.zh: 工地的噪音打扰了学生们。

example.en: Don't bother booking a taxi; the hotel runs a free shuttle.
example.zh: 不必费心叫出租车，酒店有免费班车。

example.en: Loud phone conversations on trains annoy many passengers.
example.zh: 在火车上大声打电话让许多乘客感到恼火。

example.en: The constant delays began to irritate the travellers.
example.zh: 接连不断的延误开始激怒旅客。

example.en: Slow internet can frustrate students studying online.
example.zh: 缓慢的网络会让上网课的学生感到沮丧。

example.en: I don't want to disappoint my parents by failing the exam.
example.zh: 我不想因考试不及格而让父母失望。

example.en: Early failures should not discourage young researchers.
example.zh: 早期的失败不应让年轻研究者气馁。

example.en: Regular hand washing helps prevent the spread of disease.
example.zh: 勤洗手有助于防止疾病传播。

example.en: Leave early to avoid the morning traffic.
example.zh: 早点出发以避开早高峰。

example.en: Reading novels is her way to escape daily pressure.
example.zh: 读小说是她逃离日常压力的方式。

example.en: It is illegal to evade paying tax.
example.zh: 逃税是违法的。

example.en: The cyclist swerved to dodge the falling branch.
example.zh: 骑车人急转弯躲开落下的树枝。

example.en: Squirrels hide nuts in autumn to eat during winter.
example.zh: 松鼠在秋天把坚果藏起来，留到冬天吃。

example.en: He tried to conceal his nervousness during the interview.
example.zh: 面试时他试图掩饰自己的紧张。

example.en: He retired early on a company pension.
example.zh: 他靠公司养老金提前退休了。

example.en: Sunscreen helps protect your skin from harmful rays.
example.zh: 防晒霜有助于保护皮肤免受有害射线伤害。

example.en: The thick walls were built to defend the city.
example.zh: 厚厚的城墙是为保卫城市而建的。

example.en: Security staff guard the museum entrance at night.
example.zh: 保安人员夜间守卫博物馆入口。

example.en: The society works to preserve historic buildings.
example.zh: 该协会致力于保护历史建筑。

example.en: It costs a lot to maintain the old library building.
example.zh: 维护这座旧图书馆大楼花费很大。

example.en: The soil cannot sustain intensive farming for long.
example.zh: 这片土壤无法长期支撑集约化耕作。

example.en: The new bus timetable comes into effect next Monday.
example.zh: 新的公交时间表下周一开始生效。

example.en: Two librarians are always on duty to assist students.
example.zh: 总有两名图书管理员值班协助学生。

example.en: The mentor scheme pairs new students with those who can help them.
example.zh: 导师计划让新生与能帮助他们的学长结对。

example.en: International aid was sent to the flooded region.
example.zh: 国际援助被送往受灾的洪水地区。

example.en: Group work can facilitate the exchange of ideas.
example.zh: 小组合作能促进思想交流。

example.en: The new card will enable students to borrow laptops.
example.zh: 新卡将使学生能够借用笔记本电脑。

example.en: Dictionaries are not allowed in the listening test.
example.zh: 听力考试中不允许使用词典。

example.en: The city will not permit building on the wetland.
example.zh: 市政府不会许可在湿地上搞建设。

example.en: Only the manager can authorize a full refund.
example.zh: 只有经理才能批准全额退款。

example.en: The committee approved the plan for a new sports hall.
example.zh: 委员会批准了新建体育馆的计划。

example.en: She was delighted to accept the job offer.
example.zh: 她很高兴地接受了这份工作邀请。

example.en: You will receive an email confirming your booking.
example.zh: 你会收到一封确认预订的电子邮件。

example.en: It takes about an hour to get to the coast by bus.
example.zh: 乘公交车到海边大约需要一小时。

example.en: Grab a leaflet from the desk on your way out.
example.zh: 出去的时候从桌上拿一份传单。

example.en: The eagle seized the fish in its sharp claws.
example.zh: 鹰用利爪抓住了鱼。

example.en: The cameras capture images of wild animals at night.
example.zh: 这些相机在夜间捕捉野生动物的影像。

example.en: Run or you won't catch the last bus.
example.zh: 快跑，不然你赶不上末班车了。

example.en: The university will hold an open day next Saturday.
example.zh: 大学下周六将举行开放日。

example.en: Please keep your receipt in case you need a refund.
example.zh: 请保留收据，以备退款之需。

example.en: It is hard to retain new words without regular review.
example.zh: 不经常复习就很难记住新单词。

example.en: I'd like to reserve a study room for tomorrow afternoon.
example.zh: 我想预订明天下午的自习室。

example.en: Cycling to work is a good way to save money.
example.zh: 骑车上班是省钱的好办法。

example.en: The second-hand bike was a real bargain at thirty pounds.
example.zh: 这辆二手自行车才三十英镑，真是便宜。

example.en: The students collect data on local air quality every week.
example.zh: 学生们每周收集当地空气质量的数据。

example.en: Please gather in the main hall at nine o'clock.
example.zh: 请九点在大礼堂集合。

example.en: All visitors should assemble at the meeting point.
example.zh: 所有游客请在集合点集合。

example.en: Toxins can accumulate in fish over time.
example.zh: 毒素会随着时间在鱼体内积累。

example.en: Over the years he amassed a huge collection of stamps.
example.zh: 多年来他积攒了大量邮票收藏。

example.en: The librarian compiled a reading list for the course.
example.zh: 图书管理员为这门课程编制了一份阅读书单。

example.en: The new centre offers a range of leisure activities.
example.zh: 新中心提供一系列休闲活动。

example.en: You must write your answers in pencil.
example.zh: 你必须用铅笔写答案。

example.en: The venue for the concert has been changed to the city hall.
example.zh: 音乐会的场地已改到市政厅。

example.en: The film documents the lives of Arctic fishermen.
example.zh: 这部影片记录了北极渔民的生活。

example.en: Make a note of the deadline in your diary.
example.zh: 把截止日期记在你的记事本上。

example.en: The class observed the birds through binoculars.
example.zh: 全班同学用双筒望远镜观察鸟类。

example.en: Thousands of people watch the boat race every year.
example.zh: 每年都有成千上万的人观看划船比赛。

example.en: From the tower you can see the whole city.
example.zh: 从塔上可以看到整座城市。

example.en: The itinerary includes two days of sightseeing in Rome.
example.zh: 行程表包括在罗马观光两天。

example.en: Look at the diagram before answering the questions.
example.zh: 回答问题前先看图表。

example.en: The doctor examined the patient's throat and ears.
example.zh: 医生检查了病人的喉咙和耳朵。

example.en: Engineers inspect the bridge for cracks every year.
example.zh: 工程师每年检查桥梁是否有裂缝。

example.en: Scientists are investigating the cause of the fish deaths.
example.zh: 科学家正在调查鱼类死亡的原因。

example.en: The programme lets children explore science through games.
example.zh: 这个项目让孩子们通过游戏探索科学。

example.en: Use the online catalogue to search for journal articles.
example.zh: 使用在线目录搜索期刊文章。

example.en: Many graduates seek work experience before further study.
example.zh: 许多毕业生在继续深造前寻求工作经验。

example.en: Did you find the reference book you were looking for?
example.zh: 你找到要找的那本参考书了吗？

example.en: Researchers hope to discover new species in the deep sea.
example.zh: 研究人员希望在深海发现新物种。

example.en: The new test can detect the disease at an early stage.
example.zh: 新的检测方法能在早期发现这种疾病。

example.en: Can you identify the main idea of each paragraph?
example.zh: 你能找出每段的中心思想吗？

example.en: I didn't recognize her with her new haircut.
example.zh: 她换了新发型，我都没认出来。

example.en: It is hard to distinguish the twins from each other.
example.zh: 很难把这对双胞胎区分开。

example.en: Colour helps the map differentiate land from water.
example.zh: 颜色帮助地图区分陆地和水域。

example.en: Please separate the glass from the paper for recycling.
example.zh: 回收时请把玻璃和纸分开。

example.en: The teacher will divide the class into two teams.
example.zh: 老师会把全班分成两队。

example.en: Let's split the cost of the taxi between us.
example.zh: 我们平摊出租车费吧。

example.en: You can leave your luggage at the hotel reception.
example.zh: 你可以把行李寄存在酒店前台。

example.en: A crack appeared in the wall after the earthquake.
example.zh: 地震后墙上出现了一道裂缝。

example.en: The vase fell from the shelf and shattered on the floor.
example.zh: 花瓶从架子上掉下来，摔得粉碎。

example.en: The fire destroyed most of the old market hall.
example.zh: 大火烧毁了旧市场大厅的大部分。

example.en: The storm damaged the roof of the sports hall.
example.zh: 暴风雨损坏了体育馆的屋顶。

example.en: Chemicals from the factory could harm river fish.
example.zh: 工厂排放的化学物质可能危害河里的鱼类。

example.en: He hurt his back while lifting heavy boxes.
example.zh: 他搬重箱子时伤了背。

example.en: Warm up properly so you don't injure your muscles.
example.zh: 好好热身，以免肌肉受伤。

example.en: The nurse cleaned the wound and covered it with a bandage.
example.zh: 护士清洗了伤口并用绷带包扎。

example.en: Tell the doctor exactly where you feel the pain.
example.zh: 告诉医生你到底哪里疼。

example.en: Coastal towns suffer badly during hurricane season.
example.zh: 飓风季节沿海城镇损失惨重。

example.en: Desert plants can endure months without rain.
example.zh: 沙漠植物能忍受数月无雨。

example.en: The old bridge cannot bear the weight of heavy lorries.
example.zh: 这座旧桥承受不住重型卡车的重量。

example.en: The library does not tolerate noise in the quiet zones.
example.zh: 图书馆的安静区不容许喧哗。

example.en: The clock tower is the most famous landmark in the town.
example.zh: 钟楼是这个镇最著名的地标。

example.en: The school has embraced new teaching technology.
example.zh: 这所学校欣然采用了新的教学技术。

example.en: The staff welcome new students at the airport.
example.zh: 工作人员在机场迎接新生。

example.en: In some cultures people greet each other with a bow.
example.zh: 在某些文化中，人们以鞠躬互相问候。

example.en: Let's meet outside the lecture theatre at two.
example.zh: 我们两点在阶梯教室外见面吧。

example.en: Hikers may encounter wild deer on this trail.
example.zh: 徒步者在这条小径上可能会遇到野鹿。

example.en: Many small shops face strong competition from supermarkets.
example.zh: 许多小商店面临超市的激烈竞争。

example.zh: 这座城市必须正视日益严重的垃圾问题。

example.zh: 她在每个到访的城市都买了一件小纪念品。

example.en: Dozens of teams compete for the university cup each year.
example.zh: 每年都有数十支队伍角逐大学杯。

example.en: She entered a national essay contest and won first prize.
example.zh: 她参加了全国作文比赛并获得一等奖。

example.zh: 医生们正在努力抗击病毒的传播。

example.zh: 一些大一学生难以安排好自己的时间。

example.zh: 小镇为反对新高速公路计划进行了长期斗争。

example.zh: 博物馆收藏有战争期间写的信件。

example.zh: 两国最终签署了和平协议。

example.zh: 口语考试时尽量保持镇静。

example.en: The top floor of the library is a quiet study area.
example.zh: 图书馆顶层是安静的自习区。

example.zh: 灯光暗下来时，观众安静了下来。

example.zh: 护士量血压时请保持不动。

example.zh: 蜥蜴一动不动，直到危险过去。

example.zh: 病人现在情况稳定。

example.zh: 学生人数一直在稳步上升。

example.en: The lab must be kept at a constant temperature.
example.zh: 实验室必须保持恒温。

example.zh: 这台机器连续记录空气质量数据。

example.zh: 不断的打扰让论文很难写完。

example.zh: 她在一家研究所找到了一份长期工作。

example.en: The trip left a lasting impression on the students.
example.zh: 这次旅行给学生们留下了持久的印象。

example.en: The two scientists formed an enduring friendship.
example.zh: 两位科学家结下了持久的友谊。

example.en: The novel explores eternal themes of love and loss.
example.zh: 这部小说探讨爱与失去的永恒主题。

example.en: The universe may be infinite in size.
example.zh: 宇宙的大小可能是无限的。

example.zh: 这张票让你在一个月内不限次数乘车。

example.en: Her boundless energy inspired the whole team.
example.zh: 她无穷的活力鼓舞了整个团队。

example.zh: 我们向西行驶时，沙漠似乎无边无际。

example.en: Countless tourists photograph this bridge every day.
example.zh: 每天都有无数游客拍摄这座桥。

example.en: The plan was rejected for numerous reasons.
example.zh: 该计划因众多原因被否决。

example.en: Many students choose to live off campus in their second year.
example.zh: 许多学生在大二时选择住在校外。

example.zh: 这道论述题有多种可能的答案。

example.zh: 这座岛全年气候温和。

example.en: Few people know about this quiet beach.
example.zh: 很少有人知道这个安静的海滩。

example.en: Some courses require students to do fieldwork.
example.zh: 有些课程要求学生做野外调查。

example.en: Call me if you have any questions about the timetable.
example.zh: 如果你对时间表有任何疑问，请给我打电话。

example.zh: 每个学生都必须参加安全说明会。

example.zh: 这一部分每题两分。

example.en: All applications must arrive before the end of June.
example.zh: 所有申请必须在六月底之前送达。

example.en: She spent the whole weekend revising for the test.
example.zh: 她整个周末都在复习备考。

example.zh: 整栋大楼因维修而关闭。

example.zh: 干旱毁掉了大部分小麦收成。

example.zh: 洪水迫使数百户家庭离开家园。

example.en: Please write your full name in capital letters.
example.zh: 请用大写字母写下你的全名。

example.en: The lab equipment gets a thorough check every month.
example.zh: 实验室设备每月接受一次彻底检查。

example.en: The handbook gives a comprehensive guide to campus services.
example.zh: 这本手册对校园服务作了全面的介绍。

example.en: Keep detailed notes of everything you observe.
example.zh: 对你观察到的一切做详细记录。

example.en: The palace is decorated with elaborate stone carvings.
example.zh: 宫殿装饰着精美复杂的石雕。

example.en: The human brain is an extremely complex organ.
example.zh: 人脑是一个极其复杂的器官。

example.zh: 预订流程对许多用户来说太复杂了。

example.en: The last question in the test was really difficult.
example.zh: 考试的最后一道题真的很难。

example.en: It is hard to concentrate in a noisy room.
example.zh: 在嘈杂的房间里很难集中注意力。

example.en: The first term abroad can be tough for new students.
example.zh: 在国外的第一个学期对新生来说可能很艰难。

example.zh: 地震损坏了该地区的几座桥梁。

example.zh: 医学是要求最高的学位课程之一。

example.en: The campus is easy to reach by public transport.
example.zh: 乘公共交通很容易到达校园。

example.en: The volcano last erupted over a century ago.
example.zh: 这座火山上一次喷发是在一百多年前。

example.en: Write your answers on a plain sheet of paper.
example.zh: 把答案写在一张白纸上。

example.en: The course covers the basic principles of economics.
example.zh: 这门课程涵盖经济学的基本原理。

example.en: Trust is fundamental to a good working relationship.
example.zh: 信任是良好合作关系的根本。

example.en: A good dictionary is essential for language learners.
example.zh: 一本好词典对语言学习者来说必不可少。

example.en: It is necessary to book the study rooms in advance.
example.zh: 自习室必须提前预订。

example.en: A valid passport is required for the exchange programme.
example.zh: 参加交换项目需要有效护照。

example.en: Attendance at the first lecture is compulsory.
example.zh: 第一节讲座必须出席。

example.en: Wearing a seat belt is mandatory in most countries.
example.zh: 在大多数国家系安全带是强制性的。

example.en: The safety course is obligatory for all lab users.
example.zh: 所有实验室使用者都必须参加安全课程。

example.en: The statistics module is optional in the final year.
example.zh: 统计学模块在最后一年是选修的。

example.en: Participation in the survey is entirely voluntary.
example.zh: 参与这项调查完全出于自愿。

example.en: Most students are willing to help with the open day.
example.zh: 大多数学生愿意为开放日帮忙。

example.en: The new interns are eager to learn everything quickly.
example.zh: 新实习生们渴望尽快学会所有东西。

example.en: She is very keen on photography and wildlife.
example.zh: 她非常热衷于摄影和野生动物。

example.en: Anyone interested in joining the choir should email the organizer.
example.zh: 有兴趣加入合唱团的人请给组织者发邮件。

example.en: Children are naturally curious about how things work.
example.zh: 孩子们天生对事物的运作原理充满好奇。

example.en: An inquisitive mind is a great asset for a researcher.
example.zh: 好奇好问的头脑是研究者的宝贵财富。

example.en: She gave the speaker an inquiring look.
example.zh: 她用探询的目光看着演讲者。

example.en: A questioning attitude is encouraged in science classes.
example.zh: 科学课上鼓励质疑的态度。

example.en: The committee was doubtful about the cost of the plan.
example.zh: 委员会对该计划的成本表示怀疑。

example.en: The future of the old theatre is still uncertain.
example.zh: 老剧院的未来仍不确定。

example.en: If you are unsure about the answer, ask your tutor.
example.zh: 如果你对答案没把握，就去问导师。

example.en: Many students were confused by the new timetable.
example.zh: 许多学生被新的时间表弄糊涂了。

example.en: She looked puzzled when she saw the exam question.
example.zh: 看到考题时她一脸迷惑。

example.en: The scientists were perplexed by the strange results.
example.zh: 科学家们对这些奇怪的结果感到困惑不解。

example.en: New arrivals often feel bewildered at the huge airport.
example.zh: 初来乍到的人在这座巨大的机场常常不知所措。

example.en: Doctors were baffled by the patient's unusual symptoms.
example.zh: 医生们对病人不寻常的症状百思不解。

example.en: The audience was mystified by the magician's final trick.
example.zh: 观众对魔术师的最后一个戏法大惑不解。

example.en: The mysterious lights in the sky turned out to be satellites.
example.zh: 天空中的神秘亮光原来是卫星。

example.en: It feels strange to hear your own recorded voice.
example.zh: 听到自己录音的声音感觉很奇怪。

example.en: It seems odd that the office is closed on a weekday.
example.zh: 办公室在工作日关门，这似乎很奇怪。

example.en: The fruit has a peculiar smell but tastes sweet.
example.zh: 这种水果有股奇特的气味，但吃起来很甜。

example.en: The glacier has retreated two kilometres since 1950.
example.zh: 自1950年以来，这条冰川已后退了两公里。

example.en: The library holds an extraordinary collection of old maps.
example.zh: 图书馆收藏着一批非凡的古地图。

example.en: The team made remarkable progress in just one term.
example.zh: 这个团队在一个学期内取得了显著进步。

example.en: She received an award for outstanding academic achievement.
example.zh: 她因杰出的学业成绩获奖。

example.en: The hotel has an excellent view of the harbour.
example.zh: 这家酒店可以看到极好的海港景色。

example.en: The orchestra gave a superb performance last night.
example.zh: 乐团昨晚的演出精彩绝伦。

example.en: The cathedral has a magnificent stained-glass window.
example.zh: 大教堂有一扇壮丽的彩色玻璃窗。

example.en: We had a splendid view of the mountains from the train.
example.zh: 从火车上我们看到了壮观的山景。

example.en: Thank you for a wonderful evening at the concert.
example.zh: 谢谢你让我度过了一个精彩的音乐会之夜。

example.en: The doctors did a marvelous job saving the patient.
example.zh: 医生们出色地救治了病人。

example.en: It is amazing how quickly children pick up languages.
example.zh: 孩子们学语言的速度之快令人惊奇。

example.en: The study revealed an astonishing fact about sleep.
example.zh: 这项研究揭示了一个关于睡眠的惊人事实。

example.en: It is surprising that so few students use the gym.
example.zh: 用健身房的学生这么少，真令人惊讶。

example.en: The report contains shocking figures about food waste.
example.zh: 这份报告包含关于食物浪费的惊人数字。

example.en: The survey produced some startling results.
example.zh: 这项调查得出了一些令人吃惊的结果。

example.en: The rainforest is disappearing at an alarming rate.
example.zh: 雨林正以令人担忧的速度消失。

example.en: The first driving lesson can be a frightening experience.
example.zh: 第一次驾驶课可能是一次吓人的经历。

example.en: Being caught in the storm at sea was terrifying.
example.zh: 在海上遭遇风暴非常恐怖。

example.en: The traffic was horrible during the festival.
example.zh: 节日期间交通糟糕透了。

example.en: The weather was terrible for the whole trip.
example.zh: 整个旅途天气都很糟糕。

example.en: The food at the conference was awful.
example.zh: 会议上的食物很难吃。

example.en: We had dreadful weather on the day of the boat trip.
example.zh: 乘船出游那天天气糟糕透顶。

example.en: Eating late at night is a bad habit.
example.zh: 深夜进食是个坏习惯。

example.en: His poor eyesight makes reading small print difficult.
example.zh: 他视力不好，读小字很吃力。

example.en: The copies are of inferior quality compared with the originals.
example.zh: 与原件相比，复印件质量较差。

example.en: The film received mediocre reviews from critics.
example.zh: 这部电影得到的影评平平。

example.en: The lighthouse stands at the tip of the peninsula.
example.zh: 灯塔矗立在半岛的顶端。

example.en: It was just an ordinary Monday morning on campus.
example.zh: 那只是校园里一个普通的周一早晨。

example.en: Africa is the second largest continent in the world.
example.zh: 非洲是世界第二大洲。

example.en: Winter in the southern hemisphere begins in June.
example.zh: 南半球的冬天从六月开始。

example.en: The climate varies greatly with latitude.
example.zh: 气候随纬度不同而差异很大。

example.en: This painting is typical of her early style.
example.zh: 这幅画是她早期风格的典型代表。

example.en: Conventional farming uses more water than the new method.
example.zh: 传统耕作方式比新方法用水更多。

example.en: The dancers wore traditional costumes at the festival.
example.zh: 舞者们在节日上穿着传统服装。

example.en: Breathing becomes harder at high altitude.
example.zh: 在高海拔地区呼吸会变得困难。

example.en: The high humidity makes summer here feel hotter.
example.zh: 高湿度让这里的夏天感觉更热。

example.en: The old lecture theatre is being renovated this summer.
example.zh: 旧的阶梯教室今年夏天正在翻修。

example.en: The charity delivers meals to aged residents.
example.zh: 慈善机构为年老的居民送餐。

example.en: The elderly couple next door often invite students for tea.
example.zh: 隔壁的老夫妇经常请学生们喝茶。

example.en: Dense vegetation covers the lower slopes of the mountain.
example.zh: 茂密的植被覆盖着山的低坡。

example.zh: 伐木正在破坏猩猩的自然栖息地。
