example.zh: 他们已长大成人的孩子如今住在不同的城市。

example.en: Recycling rates are higher in developed countries.
example.zh: 发达国家的回收率更高。

example.en: Several rare species live only on this island.
example.zh: 有几种珍稀物种只生活在这座岛上。

example.en: The museum combines modern design with old exhibits.
example.zh: 博物馆将现代设计与古老展品相结合。

example.en: The gallery shows work by contemporary artists.
example.zh: 这家画廊展出当代艺术家的作品。

example.en: The owl is a silent predator that hunts at night.
example.zh: 猫头鹰是夜间捕猎的无声捕食者。

example.en: All members were present at the annual meeting.
example.zh: 全体成员都出席了年会。

example.en: Recent research has changed our view of dolphin intelligence.
example.zh: 最近的研究改变了我们对海豚智力的看法。

example.en: The latest edition of the textbook includes online exercises.
example.zh: 教材的最新版包含在线练习。

example.en: The new sports centre opens next month.
example.zh: 新体育中心下个月开放。

example.en: The market sells fresh vegetables every morning.
example.zh: 市场每天早上出售新鲜蔬菜。

example.en: The engineers came up with a novel solution to the problem.
example.zh: 工程师们想出了一个新颖的解决方案。

example.en: The cheetah relies on speed to catch its prey.
example.zh: 猎豹靠速度捕捉猎物。

example.en: Each snowflake has a unique pattern.
example.zh: 每片雪花都有独特的图案。

example.en: The building's distinctive roof makes it easy to find.
example.zh: 这座建筑独特的屋顶让它很容易辨认。

example.en: The blue whale is the largest mammal on Earth.
example.zh: 蓝鲸是地球上最大的哺乳动物。

example.en: A reptile cannot control its body temperature internally.
example.zh: 爬行动物无法从体内调节体温。

example.en: Good nutrition is essential for children's growth.
example.zh: 良好的营养对儿童成长至关重要。

example.en: A single room in the hall costs more than a shared one.
example.zh: 宿舍单人间比合住间贵。

example.en: The sole purpose of the trip is to collect samples.
example.zh: 这次出行的唯一目的是采集样本。

example.en: This is the only bus that goes to the airport.
example.zh: 这是唯一一班开往机场的公交车。

example.zh: 她独自一人在南美旅行了一年。

example.en: Students far from home sometimes feel lonely.
example.zh: 远离家乡的学生有时会感到孤独。

example.zh: 研究站在冬天有好几个月与外界隔绝。

example.zh: 医生每月飞往偏远村庄一次。

example.en: You can see the distant mountains from the top floor.
example.zh: 从顶楼可以望见远处的群山。

example.en: The station is not far from the university.
example.zh: 车站离大学不远。

example.en: Is there a cash machine near here?
example.zh: 这附近有取款机吗？

example.en: The two lab results are very close to each other.
example.zh: 两次实验结果非常接近。

example.en: The car park is adjacent to the sports hall.
example.zh: 停车场紧挨着体育馆。

example.en: Beans are an excellent source of protein.
example.zh: 豆类是极好的蛋白质来源。

example.en: There is a nearby park where students go jogging.
example.zh: 附近有个公园，学生们常去慢跑。

example.en: The hotel offers tours of the surrounding countryside.
example.zh: 酒店提供周边乡村的游览项目。

example.en: Oranges are rich in vitamin C.
example.zh: 橙子富含维生素C。

example.zh: 故事发生在乡村背景下。

example.zh: 你常常可以根据上下文猜出单词的意思。

example.zh: 细嚼慢咽有利于消化。

example.zh: 规律的睡眠有助于保持免疫系统强健。

example.zh: 过去，大多数学生用手写论文。

example.zh: 这个志愿者岗位不要求以往经验。

example.zh: 这家以前的工厂现在是很受欢迎的艺术中心。

example.zh: 申请者无需具备该学科的预备知识。

example.zh: 更早的一项研究得出了类似的结论。

example.zh: 请在考试开始前十分钟到达。

example.zh: 讲座结束后我们可以讨论你的论文。

example.zh: 结果将于本周晚些时候公布。

example.zh: 用完整的句子回答下列问题。

example.zh: 下一班开往市区的火车从二号站台发车。

example.zh: 该理论被随后的实验所证实。

example.en: The course prepares students for future careers in media.
example.zh: 这门课程为学生未来的媒体职业做准备。

example.en: Details of the coming term are in the handbook.
example.zh: 下学期的详细安排在手册里。

example.zh: 考试临近，图书馆越来越拥挤。

example.zh: 乌云预示着暴风雨即将来临。

example.zh: 火山即将喷发的迹象令科学家们担忧。

example.zh: 海报在宣传即将举行的音乐节。

example.zh: 她即将出版的书是关于沙漠生态系统的。

example.en: Prospective students can tour the campus on Fridays.
example.zh: 准学生们可以在周五参观校园。

example.en: The site has great potential for wind power.
example.zh: 这个地点具有发展风电的巨大潜力。

example.en: Book early if possible, as seats fill up quickly.
example.zh: 如有可能请尽早预订，座位很快订满。

example.en: The probable cause of the delay was the bad weather.
example.zh: 延误很可能是坏天气造成的。

example.en: It is likely that the lecture will be recorded.
example.zh: 这场讲座很可能会被录下来。

example.en: It is unlikely to rain during the dry season.
example.zh: 旱季不太可能下雨。

example.en: It is impossible to finish the reading list in one week.
example.zh: 一周内读完书单上的书是不可能的。

example.en: Success seemed improbable, but the team kept trying.
example.zh: 成功似乎希望渺茫，但团队仍不断尝试。

example.en: The committee will decide whether the plan is feasible.
example.zh: 委员会将决定该计划是否可行。

example.en: Solar power is now a viable option for many homes.
example.zh: 太阳能现在对许多家庭来说是切实可行的选择。

example.en: The new vaccine protects against several types of flu.
example.zh: 新疫苗可预防几种流感。

example.en: Set realistic goals for your first term.
example.zh: 为第一学期设定现实的目标。

example.en: The actual cost was much higher than the estimate.
example.zh: 实际费用比估算高得多。

example.en: The film is based on real events.
example.zh: 这部电影根据真实事件改编。

example.en: She showed a genuine interest in the local culture.
example.zh: 她对当地文化表现出真正的兴趣。

example.en: The restaurant serves authentic Thai food.
example.zh: 这家餐厅供应正宗的泰国菜。

example.en: Decide whether each statement is true or false.
example.zh: 判断每个陈述是正确还是错误。

example.en: The article contains several false claims.
example.zh: 这篇文章包含几处不实说法。

example.en: The museum discovered that the painting was fake.
example.zh: 博物馆发现这幅画是赝品。

example.en: The stadium uses artificial grass all year round.
example.zh: 这座体育场全年使用人造草坪。

example.en: Synthetic fabrics dry faster than cotton.
example.zh: 合成面料比棉布干得快。

example.en: A sore throat is often the first symptom of a cold.
example.zh: 喉咙痛往往是感冒的最初症状。

example.en: Organic vegetables are grown without chemical fertilisers.
example.zh: 有机蔬菜不使用化肥种植。

example.en: The lab studies the biological effects of noise on birds.
example.zh: 实验室研究噪音对鸟类的生物学影响。

example.en: An early diagnosis greatly improves the chance of recovery.
example.zh: 早期诊断能大大提高康复的机会。

example.en: You need a prescription from a doctor for this medicine.
example.zh: 这种药需要医生开处方才能买。

example.en: The library received a substantial donation last year.
example.zh: 图书馆去年收到了一笔可观的捐赠。

example.en: Building the bridge took a considerable amount of time.
example.zh: 建造这座桥花费了相当长的时间。

example.en: There was a significant drop in air pollution last year.
example.zh: 去年空气污染显著下降。

example.en: It is important to back up your work regularly.
example.zh: 定期备份你的作业很重要。

example.en: Timing is crucial when planting these seeds.
example.zh: 种这些种子时，时机至关重要。

example.en: Clean water is critical to the village's survival.
example.zh: 干净的水对这个村庄的生存至关重要。

example.en: Bees are vital for pollinating food crops.
example.zh: 蜜蜂对粮食作物授粉至关重要。

example.en: The pharmacy on campus opens until nine at night.
example.zh: 校内药房营业到晚上九点。

example.en: Tourism is a key industry on the island.
example.zh: 旅游业是这座岛的关键产业。

example.en: The main entrance is on the north side of the building.
example.zh: 正门在大楼北侧。

example.en: The primary aim of the project is to reduce waste.
example.zh: 该项目的首要目标是减少浪费。

example.en: The principal reason for the delay was a staff shortage.
example.zh: 延误的主要原因是人手短缺。

example.en: Rice is the chief crop of the region.
example.zh: 水稻是该地区的主要作物。

example.en: He needed minor surgery on his knee after the match.
example.zh: 比赛后他的膝盖需要做个小手术。

example.en: There are a few minor errors in the report.
example.zh: 报告中有几处小错误。

example.en: She made a full recovery within six weeks.
example.zh: 她在六周内完全康复了。

example.en: The company opened a subsidiary office in Singapore.
example.zh: 这家公司在新加坡开设了附属办事处。

example.en: The hospital hired more auxiliary staff for the winter.
example.zh: 医院为冬季增聘了更多辅助人员。

example.en: Supplementary reading materials are posted online.
example.zh: 补充阅读材料发布在网上。

example.en: Additional copies of the handout are available at the desk.
example.zh: 讲义的额外副本可在服务台领取。

example.en: Hot lemon tea is a traditional remedy for a cold.
example.zh: 热柠檬茶是治感冒的传统偏方。

example.en: Always carry a spare battery for your camera.
example.zh: 一定要为相机带一块备用电池。

example.en: Surplus food from the canteen is given to a local charity.
example.zh: 食堂剩余的食物捐给了当地慈善机构。

example.en: Passengers must pay for luggage in excess of twenty kilos.
example.zh: 行李超过二十公斤的乘客需要付费。

example.en: Excessive screen time can affect children's sleep.
example.zh: 过多的屏幕时间会影响儿童睡眠。

example.en: The desert is known for its extreme temperatures.
example.zh: 这片沙漠以极端气温著称。

example.en: Athletes follow an intense training programme before the games.
example.zh: 运动员在赛前进行高强度训练。

example.en: The region suffered a severe drought last summer.
example.zh: 该地区去年夏天遭遇了严重干旱。

example.en: Plagiarism is a serious offence at university.
example.zh: 抄袭在大学里是严重的违规行为。

example.en: The doctor looked grave as she read the results.
example.zh: 医生看结果时神情严肃。

example.en: The building is in urgent need of repair.
example.zh: 这栋建筑急需修缮。

example.en: Housing is the most pressing problem facing the city.
example.zh: 住房是这座城市面临的最紧迫的问题。

example.en: The new rules will take immediate effect.
example.zh: 新规定将立即生效。

example.en: The app gives instant feedback on your pronunciation.
example.zh: 这款应用对你的发音给出即时反馈。

example.en: Thank you for your prompt reply to my email.
example.zh: 感谢你对我邮件的迅速回复。

example.en: Let's have a quick look at the map before we set off.
example.zh: 出发前我们快速看一下地图。

example.en: The disease spreads at a rapid rate in crowded cities.
example.zh: 这种疾病在拥挤的城市里传播迅速。

example.en: The lifeguard made a swift decision to enter the water.
example.zh: 救生员迅速决定下水救人。

example.en: The fast train reaches the capital in two hours.
example.zh: 快车两小时到达首都。

example.en: Progress on the new library has been slow.
example.zh: 新图书馆的工程进展缓慢。

example.en: There has been a gradual improvement in water quality.
example.zh: 水质在逐渐改善。

example.en: The school takes a progressive approach to homework.
example.zh: 这所学校对家庭作业采取渐进的方式。

example.en: The project advances in small incremental steps.
example.zh: 这个项目以小步递增的方式推进。

example.en: She is a prominent figure in environmental research.
example.zh: 她是环境研究领域的知名人物。

example.en: The flu epidemic closed schools across the region.
example.zh: 流感疫情使全地区的学校停课。

example.en: Her exam results have been consistent all year.
example.zh: 她全年的考试成绩一直很稳定。

example.en: The bricks are cut to a uniform size.
example.zh: 这些砖被切成统一的尺寸。

example.en: Divide the mixture into two equal parts.
example.zh: 把混合物分成相等的两份。

example.en: The twins wore identical jackets to the party.
example.zh: 这对双胞胎穿着完全相同的外套参加聚会。

example.en: We take the same bus to campus every morning.
example.zh: 我们每天早上乘同一班公交车去学校。

example.en: The two essays reach similar conclusions.
example.zh: 这两篇论文得出了相似的结论。

example.en: The sisters look remarkably alike.
example.zh: 这对姐妹长得非常像。

example.en: The two cities are comparable in size and population.
example.zh: 这两座城市在面积和人口上不相上下。

example.en: The qualification is equivalent to a British degree.
example.zh: 该资格等同于英国学位。

example.en: Good personal hygiene helps prevent infection.
example.zh: 良好的个人卫生有助于预防感染。

example.en: The city is home to people from diverse cultural backgrounds.
example.zh: 这座城市居住着来自多元文化背景的人们。
